Cloud-powered pestles husk the white rice, in the vegetarian kitchen, the fragrance of cinnamon boils.
A hundred hardships shame the swallow's beak, a single fill comforts the tortoise's stomach.
In the whole world, few are true confidants, all my life I've been busy for my mouth.
When can I abandon my official hat and tablet, to grow old and shut myself in a mountain cottage.

src:
肥水不能遠，祇今行子東。
高秋千里月，暮景一帆風。
時節迎黄菊，汀洲下早鴻。
江天多勝事，無術與君同。
tgt:
The fertile waters cannot be far away; only now the traveler goes east.
In late autumn, a thousand miles of moonlight; at dusk, a sail in the wind.
The season welcomes the yellow chrysanthemums; on the sandbar, early wild geese come down.
The river and sky hold many splendid things; I have no way to share them with you.

src:
只道成都路八千，誰知從此便西川。
行人一見成深省，大道多歧穩著鞭。
tgt:
They said the road to Chengdu stretches eight thousand li,
Who knew that from here on it would all be western Sichuan?
A traveler, at one glance, is brought to deep reflection,
The great road forks in many ways—hold the whip steady.

src:
億萬饑民久籲天，天開上瑞豈徒然。
深潭龜拆寒莎底，淺土蝗遺宿麥邊。
厲氣已消除日後，祥霙飛墮曉風前。
醉吟樓上瀛洲客，爲記三登第一年。
tgt:
Millions of starving people have long appealed to Heaven; that Heaven now sends down auspicious snow is surely no accident.
In the deep pool, turtle shells crack beneath the cold sedge; on shallow soil, locusts leave their remnants beside last year's wheat.
The baleful air has already dispersed after the days of calamity; auspicious snowflakes fly and fall before the morning wind.
A guest from Yingzhou, drunk and chanting on the tower, records this as the first year of threefold abundance.

src:
耳目肺肠，不由我乎，更由乎谁。
也不必君平，不消詹尹，不疑何卜，不卜何疑。
三径归来，一时有见，岂为黄初与义熙。
天下事，但行其可，自合乎宜。
大哉用易乘时。
纵乌喙那能食子皮。
叹失若塞翁，失为得本，赢如刘毅，赢乃输基。
大黠小痴，有馀不足，谁必彭殇早与迟。
眼前物，纵铜山金屋，一瞑全非。
tgt:
Eyes, ears, lungs, and intestines—are they not up to me, then up to whom?
No need for Lord Ping, no need for Zhan Yin; without doubt why divine, without divining why doubt?
Returning by three paths, in a moment there is insight—how could it be for Huangchu or Yixi?
The affairs of the world: just do what can be done, and it will naturally accord with what is fitting.
Great indeed is using change to seize the time.
Even a raven's beak cannot eat the child's skin.
Sigh—loss like the old man at the frontier: loss is the root of gain; winning like Liu Yi: winning is the foundation of losing.
Great cunning, small folly; surplus and insufficiency—who can be sure Peng and Shang are early or late?
The things before the eyes—even a copper mountain and golden house, once the eyes close, are all no more.

src:
小作王官試，還爲幕府留。
綺歌偶意改，散號覓歸休。
屈賈當重作，瀟湘漫一遊。
胡爲車未發，已報病難瘳。
tgt:
A minor official I tried, yet stayed in the office.
My ornate songs casually changed, seeking rest and retirement.
Qu Yuan and Jia Yi should rewrite, wandering freely in Xiaoxiang.
Why hasn't the carriage departed, yet it's reported the illness is hard to cure.

src:
迢迢萬餘里，領我赴三軍。
軍中異苦樂，主將寧盡聞。
隔河見胡騎，倏忽數百羣。
我始爲奴僕，幾時樹功勳。
tgt:
Far, far away, more than ten thousand li,
You lead me to join the three armies.
In the army, bitter and joyful lots differ,
How can the chief general hear them all?
Across the river I see Hu cavalry,
In a flash, several hundred troops.
I have only just become a servant,
When can I establish merit and honor?

src:
無端盡把潑衆私，攤向人前誰點癡。
對面不能掀倒去，滿天風雨謾凄其。
tgt:
For no reason, I aired all my private affairs,
Spread them before others—who would note such folly?
Face to face, I cannot overturn and cast them away,
The whole sky's wind and rain rage bleakly in vain.

src:
刮膜神方直萬金，國醫曾費一生心。
可憐髽髻提籃者，也有盲人問點鍼。
tgt:
The miraculous prescription for scraping the film is worth ten thousand gold,
The imperial physician once spent a lifetime of effort.
Pitiful are those with coiled hair carrying baskets,
There are also blind people asking for acupuncture.

src:
照時遠近俱到，用時毫髪無遺。
直得二途不涉，方能照用同時。
趯倒趙州略彴，拈起馬師簸箕。
任待通身是眼，當陽未免膠𥻿。
tgt:
When illuminating, it reaches both near and far; when functioning, it leaves nothing out, not even a hair.
Only by not involving the two paths can one attain illumination and function at the same time.
Kick over Zhaozhou's little bridge, pick up Master Ma's winnowing basket.
Even if the whole body were an eye, in broad daylight it would still be stuck and muddled.

src:
海上窮秋白日陰，霜飈獵獵稍相侵。
手持黄菊江南意，目送征鴻萬里心。
每想清談真麗矚，欲彈流水少知音。
東山兄弟非難繼，誰敢先爲招隠吟。

摩遮本出海西胡，琉璃寶服紫髯鬍。
聞道皇恩遍宇宙，來將歌舞助歡娛。
tgt:
The Mozhe dance comes from the Western Hu, with glass-like robes and purple-bearded men.
Hearing that the emperor's grace spreads across the universe, they come with song and dance to add to the joy.

src:
自方國小難回袖，不畏秦彊欲奏盆。
遙想調琴堂上日，仁風曾使滿千門。
tgt:
From childhood, hard to turn back the sleeve,
Not fearing Qin's might, I wish to present the basin.
Thinking back to the days of tuning the zither in the hall,
The benevolent wind once filled a thousand gates.

src:
竹裏繰絲挑網車，青蟬獨噪日光斜。
桃膠迎夏香琥珀，自課越傭能種瓜。
tgt:
In the bamboo grove, silk reels and web-picking carts, a green cicada shrills alone as sunlight slants.
Peach gum welcomes summer, fragrant as amber; I teach the Yue servant to grow melons.

src:
烽火城西百尺樓，黃昏獨上海風秋。
更吹橫笛關山月，誰解金閨萬里愁。

宵柝迢迢警睡魔，靜思甘分老林坡。
忍胞只有嵇康嬾，扣角曾無甯戚歌。
不起妄心思世事，只將閒意養天和。
時人休說長生術，學著長生事轉多。
tgt:
The night watchman's clapper far off warns the sleep demon away,
In quiet thought, content to grow old on forest slopes I stay.
Only Ji Kang's laziness can bear this lonely fate,
No Ning Qi's song, no horn-tapping at the gate.
No wild thoughts rise to vex me with the world's affairs,
Just idle ease to nourish heaven's harmony and cares.
Let people cease to speak of arts for endless life,
Who seeks long life finds more and more of strife.

src:
傾國傾城豈在人，人間只有此花新。
冰霜過了翩然去，萬紫千紅各占春。
tgt:
A beauty that could topple a kingdom does not lie in people; in this world, only this flower is fresh.
Once the ice and frost have passed, it lightly goes away; ten thousand purples and a thousand reds each claim their share of spring.

src:
亭伯去安在，李陵降未歸。
愁容變海色，短服改胡衣。
tgt:
Where has the noble lord gone?
Li Ling surrendered, not yet returned.
His sorrowful face changed like the sea's hue,
His short garb altered to barbarian clothes.

src:
人生久矣無百年，六十七十已爲壽。
嗟予忽忽蹈此境，衰髮如蓬面枯瘦。
孤松摧折老澗壑，病馬凄凉依棧豆。
尚無籌策活目前，豈有功名付身後。
壁疏風入燈焰揺，地爐火盡寒蕭蕭。
胸中白虹吐千丈，庭樹葉空衣未纊。
tgt:
Life is long, yet none live a hundred years; at sixty or seventy, one is already considered blessed with longevity.
Alas, I hurriedly tread into this state, my thinning hair like tangled weeds, my face withered and gaunt.
A lone pine, broken and fallen, lies in an old ravine; a sick horse, desolate, leans by the stable's fodder.
I still have no plan to survive the present, how could I leave behind fame and merit after death?
Through cracks in the wall, wind enters, making the lamp flame waver; the ground stove's fire is out, and coldness whistles bleakly.
In my chest, a white rainbow exhales a thousand zhang; the courtyard trees are bare of leaves, yet my clothes are still unlined.

src:
石溜吐陰崖，泉聲滿空谷。
能邀弄泉客，繫舸留巖腹。
陰精分月窟，水味標茶錄。
共約試春芽，槍旗幾時綠。
tgt:
A stone channel spouts from the shaded cliff,
The sound of spring fills the empty vale.
It can invite the spring-playing guest,
To moor his boat within the rocky heart.
The shaded essence parts the moonlit cave,
Its water's taste is noted in tea records.
Together we agree to try spring buds,
How soon will the spear and flag turn green?

src:
手得封題手自開，一篇美玉綴玫瑰。
衆知圓媚難論報，自顧窮愁敢角才。
君卧南陽惟畎畝，我行西路亦風埃。
相逢不必嗟勞事，尚欲賡歌咏起哉。
tgt:
I seal the letter myself and open it with my own hand,
a piece of fine jade adorned with roses.
Everyone knows your flawless grace is hard to repay,
while I look at my own poverty and sorrow, daring to compete in talent.
You lie in Nanyang among the fields,
I travel the western road amid wind and dust.
When we meet, we need not sigh over toilsome matters,
I still want to continue singing and chant, "Rise up!"

src:
曾聽道公語，先師愛此梅。
但知傳說老，不記若年栽。
半樹枯仍發，疎花晚自開。
方兄頭又白，常喜故人來。
tgt:
I once heard the Daoist priest say, the late master loved this plum tree.
I only know the tale is old, but don't recall in what year it was planted.
Half the tree is withered yet still sprouts, sparse blossoms open late on their own.
Brother Fang's hair has turned white again, yet he always delights when old friends come.

src:
蔡倫池北雁峰前，罹亂相兼十九年。
所喜故人猶會面，不堪良牧已重泉。
醉思把筯欹歌席，狂憶判身入酒船。
今日與君贏得在，戴家灣裏兩皤然。
tgt:
North of Cai Lun's Pool, before the Wild Goose Peak,
Through troubles and chaos, nineteen years did seek.
I'm glad old friends can still meet face to face,
But can't bear that good officials rest in deep.
Drunk, I think of holding chopsticks, leaning on song mats,
Wildly recalling throwing myself into wine boats.
Today with you, we've won the chance to be,
In Dai Family Bay, two white-haired folks.

src:
軒冕三從盛，門庭五福優。
凄凉孝子淚，悲慟故山秋。
楊子新阡啟，班昭舊史留。
空堂對萱草，無復更忘憂。
tgt:
The cap and carriage thrice followed, prosperity's honor grand,
The household enjoyed five blessings, noble and bland.
How desolate the tears of a filial son,
Mourning in the autumn of his native mountain.
Yangzi's new path opens, a fresh start,
Ban Zhao's old history remains, a timeless art.
In the empty hall, facing daylilies, I stand,
No longer can I forget my sorrow, close at hand.

src:
吏散庭空晝掩扃，行春只到柳邊亭。
唱酬共喜摛鴻藻，來往何勞笑白丁。
一笑歌呼從自醉，幾年燠暍爲誰醒。
定知細札褒揚後，名入麟臺汗簡青。
tgt:
The clerks have left, the court is empty; by day the gate is closed.
I make my spring excursion only to the pavilion by the willows.
Singing and replying together, we delight in spreading out grand verse;
Coming and going, why trouble to laugh at the common folk?
With one laugh, singing and shouting, I follow my own drunkenness.
For years, in heat and sun, for whom have I stayed sober?
I know for certain that after fine tablets praise and spread his name,
His name will enter the Qilin Hall, on the sweat-green bamboo slips.

src:
不謂擒胡月，妖星犯將營。
伊吾空有志，渭上不成耕。
衆議磨圭玷，他年聽鼓聲。
何妨築高冢，爲象順昌城。

哦詩谷虛響，散髮下巖半。
披叢澗影摇，集鳥紛然散。
tgt:
Oh, the poem valley echoes with emptiness, hair unbound, descending halfway down the cliff.
Brushing through thickets, the stream's shadow sways; gathering birds scatter in confusion.

src:
麝煤鼠尾要鎸汝，頮面沃心誰似吾。
老子胸中十萬讀，莫年相喣復相濡。
tgt:
Ink and brush must engrave you; who else like me can wash your face and soak your heart?
This old man has read a hundred thousand books in his chest; in late years we moisten each other and keep each other alive.

src:
万事到头无益已。
寻思只有修行是。
若送此心游宝地。
还容易。
坐观落日当西坠。
万顷红光归眼际。
眼开眼闭长明媚。
此观成时知法味。
心欢喜。
临终决定生莲里。
tgt:
When all things come to an end, there is no benefit.
Thinking it over, only cultivation is real.
If you send this mind to wander in the precious land,
It is still easy.
Sit and watch the setting sun as it sinks in the west.
A vast expanse of red light enters the horizon of the eyes.
Eyes open, eyes closed, ever bright and beautiful.
When this contemplation is perfected, one knows the flavor of the Dharma.
The mind rejoices.
At the end of life, one will surely be born within the lotus.

src:
两两轻红半晕腮。
依依独为使君回。
若道使君无此意。
何为。
双花不向别人开。
但看低昂烟雨里。
不已。
劝君休诉十分杯。
更问尊前狂副使。
来岁。
花开时节与谁来。
tgt:
Two by two light red blooms half-blush on the cheeks.
Lingering, alone, they make the governor return.
If you say the governor has no such intent,
Why then
Do the twin flowers not open for anyone else?
Just watch them rise and fall in the mist and rain.
Without end.
I urge you not to refuse a full cup.
And ask further of the wild deputy before the wine.
Next year,
When the flowers bloom, with whom will they be?

src:
暖傍漁船睡不驚，可憐孤潔似華亭。
晚來灣浦衝平碧，晴過汀洲拂淺青。
翡翠靜中修羽翼，鴛鴦閑處事儀形。
何如飛入漢宮裏，留與興亡作典經。
tgt:
Warm beside the fishing boat, it sleeps unstartled; pitiable and solitary, pure as Huating.
At evening it glides across the calm jade shallows; when clear, it brushes the light green past the sandbars.
In the quiet, kingfishers preen their wings; where mandarin ducks rest, they compose their dignified forms.
How would it be to fly into the Han palace, and be left as a classic through rise and fall?

src:
去歲秋霖麥下遲，臘殘一雪潤無泥。
相將飽喫滹沱飯，來聽林間快活啼。
tgt:
Last autumn's rain delayed the wheat sowing,
Year-end snow moistened soil without mud.
Soon we'll eat our fill of Hutuo's rice,
And come to hear the joyful cries in the woods.

src:
尚想溪亭跨鴨頭，市囂到曉不曾休。
角聲吹斷老梅月，橋影壓翻寒葦秋。
三語固知非昔比，十年不到使人愁。
老來著脚茆峯下，相望何殊風馬牛。
tgt:
Still I think of the creek pavilion where we crossed the duck's head,
The market's clamor lasted till dawn and never ceased.
The horn's sound blows apart the old plum moon,
The bridge's shadow presses down and overturns the cold reed autumn.
Three words, indeed I know, are not what they were before,
Ten years without arriving make a person grieve.
In old age I set foot beneath the thatch peak,
Gazing at each other, how different from wind, horse, and cow.

src:
酒當毒藥色當斤，人生行樂如浮雲，一杯更盡客已醺。
美人不用歌文君，客有相如心不春。
tgt:
Wine serves as poison, lust as weight, life's pleasures drift like clouds, one more cup and the guest is drunk.
No need for the beauty to sing of Wenjun, the guest has Xiangru's heart, yet spring does not stir.

src:
明珠在掌猶遺墜，輝玉囊中不失時。
幸有觀音玉環手，何勞更誦夢熊詩。
tgt:
The bright pearl in the palm still slips and falls,
The radiant jade in the pouch does not miss its time.
Fortunately, there is Guanyin's jade-ringed hand,
Why bother to recite the dream-of-bear poem anymore?

src:
力田元不怵凶饑，瘠者爲誰誰是肥。
但得髙堂翁媪健，定知奕世子孫宜。
追風騏驥驟仍蹶，覽徳鸞鳯棲或飛。
有酒急須頻對月，桂枝香了到梅枝。
tgt:
Toiling in the fields, one never fears famine or disaster,
Who are the lean, and who are the fat?
As long as the elders in the high hall remain strong,
Surely generation after generation of descendants will thrive.
The steed that chases the wind may gallop then stumble,
The phoenix that beholds virtue may perch or fly.
When there is wine, one must quickly raise it to the moon,
After the cassia's fragrance comes the plum branch's.

src:
長淮準擬濯塵埃，漢節何妨一往回。
杜宇不知歸路近，樹頭聲急更相催。
tgt:
I planned to wash away the dust in the long Huai River,
Why not make a trip back with the Han envoy's tally?
The cuckoo doesn't know the road home is near,
From the treetops its urgent calls urge me on all the more.

src:
踢倒凈瓶呼木𣔻，華林已坐一生窮。
却教一座溈山主，都在頭陀相法中。
tgt:
Kicked over the pure vase, called out to the wooden stump; at Hualin he had already sat, a lifetime poor.
Yet he made the master of a whole Weishan,
all within the dharma-form of a wandering ascetic.

src:
詩題蔗境不題名，墨蹟懸巖碧蘚平。
游宦來看心忽悟，前身應是趙先生。
tgt:
The poem's title isn't inscribed in the sugarcane realm, ink traces on the cliff, green moss level.
Traveling officials come to see, the heart suddenly awakens, in a former life, it must have been Mr. Zhao.

src:
〔角一曲〕四溟廣矣，八紘是紀。
我宅東南，迴復萬里。
洪濤飄風，安危所倚。
祀事特隆，神其戾止。
tgt:
The four seas are vast, the eight directions are recorded.
I reside in the southeast, where the expanse stretches ten thousand miles.
Great waves and wild winds, on which safety and danger depend.
The sacrificial rites are especially grand, may the deities arrive.

src:
天驕飽肉氣勇决，憶昨彎弧射漢月。
玉關保障烽燧驚，豺狼塞路人蹤絕。
將軍方著從事衫，指揮義士征河南。
設奇間道依嵩谷，百戰崎嶇不解驂。
攻城陷陣收殊績，捷書夜到甘泉北。
天子興嗟恨見晚，俾將樓船護江國。
將軍擊檝誓中流，英風凜凜氣橫秋。
胡爲拘縶不得逞，歸戴南冠效楚囚。
一朝奮激肝膽露，剌剌羞聞婢子語。
袖携文字幾千言，徑趍閶闔排雲去。
帝敕天丁下取將，玉音誦之聲琅琅。
侍臣却立屏東箱，奇謀創見驚未嘗。
明日北門天子詔，似怪十年猶不調。
盡還故秩問所從，豪傑中原資號召。
我今塵敝黑貂裘，藥裹關心萬事休。
挑燈看劍夜無寐，耿耿猶懷嫠婦憂。
相期談笑青油幕，關河去展規恢略。
燕然碣石與天齊，爲君重勒千丈碑。
tgt:
The proud and favored one, well-fed on meat, his spirit bold and resolute,
Remembering yesterday, he bent his bow to shoot at the Han moon.
The Jade Pass guards, beacon fires alarmed,
Jackals and wolves block the road, human traces cut off.
The general now dons his service robe,
Commanding righteous warriors to march on Henan.
Setting ambushes on hidden paths along the Song Valley,
Through a hundred battles rugged and steep, he never loosens the reins.
Taking cities, storming formations, gathering extraordinary merit,
Victory dispatches arrive at Ganquan's north by night.
The Son of Heaven sighs, regretting having met him late,
Orders him to command tower ships guarding the river lands.
The general strikes his oar, swearing at midstream,
His heroic bearing, stern and awe-inspiring, spirit sweeping autumn.
Why then is he bound and fettered, unable to fulfill his will,
Returning wearing the southern cap, playing the Chu prisoner?
One morning, stirred to action, his liver and gall exposed,
Stung with shame to hear the maidservant's words.
In his sleeve he carries writings of several thousand words,
Straight to the Heavenly Gate, pushing through clouds he goes.
The Emperor commands heavenly guards to bring him down,
The jade-like voice recites them, the sound clear and bright.
Attendant ministers stand back, retreating to the eastern chamber,
The wondrous strategy, newly seen, astonishes as never before.
The next day, from the northern gate, the Son of Heaven's edict,
As if wondering why for ten years he was still not promoted.
Restoring fully his former rank, asking whom he follows,
Heroes of the Central Plains are rallied by his call.
I now, dusty and worn, in black sable fur,
Medicine wraps concern my heart, ten thousand matters cease.
Trimming the lamp, I look at my sword, sleepless through the night,
Still deeply bearing the sorrow of a widow.
We pledge to meet, talking and laughing in the blue-oiled tent,
To go to the passes and rivers, unfolding plans of grand design.
Mount Yanran and Jieshi, towering level with the sky,
For you I will again carve a thousand-zhang stele.

src:
場屋追兄弟，閨門託婦壬。
傳家深屬契，爲客細論心。
何物尉乃勇，所居官不侵。
相期愛蜩甲，突兀看穹林。
tgt:
In the examination hall I follow my brothers, in the women's quarters I entrust myself to the women.
The transmission of the family deeply depends on our bond, as a guest I carefully discuss my heart.
What thing makes a petty officer so brave, the office he holds is not encroached upon.
We agree to cherish the cicada's shell, toweringly gazing at the vast forest.

src:
分手頻曾變寒暑，迢迢遠意各何如。
波濤一阻兩鄉夢，歲月無過雙鯉魚。
吟處落花藏筆硯，睡時斜雨濕圖書。
此來俗輩皆疎我，唯有故人心不疎。
tgt:
Partings have often turned cold and warm through the years; how fares each distant thought so far away?
One stretch of waves blocks dreams of two home places; the years have brought no more than a pair of carp letters.
Where I chant, fallen blossoms hide my brush and inkstone; when I sleep, slanting rain dampens my books.
Since I came, vulgar crowds all keep their distance from me; only an old friend’s heart is not distant.

src:
世態螳螂謾捕蟬，誰知富貴本由天。
但令冊府荷氷鑑，何必熏爐擁燧煙。
一曲賜來成別墅，百杯贏得吸晴川。
可人過我談名理，月到紗窗興欲仙。
tgt:
The world's a mantis stalking cicadas in vain, who knows wealth and honor are decreed by heaven.
But if the archives bear the ice-mirror's clarity, why need a censer's warmth and smoke?
A single song bestowed becomes a villa; a hundred cups won, I drink in the clear river.
A lovely guest visits me to discuss profound truths; the moon reaches the gauze window, my spirit soars like an immortal.

src:
朱欄芳草綠纖纖，欹枕高堂捲晝簾。
處處落花春寂寂，時時中酒病懨懨。
塞鴻信斷雖堪訝，梁燕詞多且莫嫌。
自有卷書銷永日，霜華未用鬢邊添。
tgt:
Red railings, fragrant grass, slender and green,
Leaning on my pillow in the high hall, I roll up the daytime curtain.
Everywhere fallen flowers, spring is silent and still,
From time to time, drunk, I feel sick and weary.
Though it's surprising that the frontier geese bring no letters,
Do not blame the beam swallows for their many chirps.
I have my books to pass the long days,
No need for frosty blossoms to add to my temples.

src:
塵滿胡床淚滿衣，深閨寂寂鎖相思。
一春幽恨無人共，手撚梨花腸斷時。
tgt:
Dust covers the barbarian bed, tears soak the clothes; in the deep chamber, silent and still, longing is locked away.
All spring, a hidden grief no one shares with me; twisting a pear blossom in my hand, my heart breaks.

src:
水聲長在耳，山色不離門。
掃地樹留影，拂牀琴有聲。
落日長安道，秋槐滿地花。
tgt:
The sound of water stays in my ears, mountain views never leave my door.
Sweeping the ground, trees cast shadows; brushing the bed, the lute gives sound.
At sunset on Chang'an's road, autumn locust blossoms cover the ground.

src:
數畝涵空碧，波光可染衣。
荷枯惟藕在，荻老作花飛。
水浄遊鱗見，天寒過鴈稀。
十分清絕處，秋月散明輝。
tgt:
Several acres hold an emerald void, where wave-light can dye one's clothes.
Lotus withered, only the root remains; reeds grown old, their flowers drift as fluff.
The water clear, swimming scales are seen; the sky cold, passing geese are few.
At this most utterly pure and matchless place, the autumn moon scatters its bright radiance.

src:
奉引歸來春晚時，扁舟便欲訪天隨。
都忘舊學塵埃滿，頓覺新年氣宇衰。
遽有恩榮騰紫詔，了無功業立彤墀。
先生妙句煩褒借，一夕光涵月不虧。
tgt:
Summoned back when spring was late, I thought to seek the hermit's way by boat.
Forgot how dusty my old learning grew, and felt the new year's spirit fade.
Suddenly grace and glory rose in a purple edict, yet no deeds stood on the crimson steps.
Your wondrous lines trouble you to lend praise; one night's light holds the moon unwaning.

src:
樂已終，[煙]燎上。
懷靈惠，結皇想。
歸風疾，迴風爽。
百[福]來，衆神往。
tgt:
The music has ended, the smoke rises.
Cherishing spiritual grace, forming imperial thoughts.
The returning wind is swift, the swirling wind is fresh.
A hundred blessings arrive, the many gods depart.

src:
遨遊海上冀逢人，宴坐山中長閉門。
去住只今誰定是，相逢一笑各無言。
tgt:
Roaming the seas, I hope to meet someone;
Sitting in the mountains, I keep the door shut long.
Who can decide now whether to leave or stay?
Meeting, we smile, and each says not a word.

src:
愧面何堪見客星，移舟且莫近前汀。
鷗沙草長連江暗，蟹舍潮回带雨腥。
歸去尚餘初繭栗，生來能費幾笭箵。
詩腸一夜生芒角，試問故人雙玉缾。

海枯龍去雨淋淋，羯鼓諠譁山禁林。
虎士墮弢兵力倦，鷄人罷箭漏聲沈。
鶑摇御柳春猶閙，燕蹴宮花霧轉深。
腸斷木綿庵裏客，可憐郿塢築黄金。

禹畫九州，河內曰冀。
霍山崇崇，作鎮積勢。
我祀如何，百末旨味。
承神燕娭，諸神畢至。
tgt:
Yu delineated the Nine Provinces; north of the river was called Ji.
Mount Huo rises lofty and high, forming a stabilizing, accumulated force.
How do we sacrifice? With fine flavors from a hundred tips.
We welcome the gods to feast and play; all the gods have arrived.

src:
黑吃黑 天下乌鸦一般黑
鬼扮鬼脸 小人养小鬼
谍对谍 多滴几滴眼药水
鳄鱼眼泪 楚楚装可怜
阴阳魔界 天高皇帝远
色戒魔戒 爱人最难戒
美人太美 英雄会太累
孽缘自作孽
天诛地灭 天杀的想念
杀手杀红了双眼
赶尽杀绝 杀不死悬念
杀光风景杀时间
三头六臂 一手遮天
三十六计 溜走为先
七十二变 让子弹飞
天下无贼 最贼的是老天

蛇与蝎 狼狈为奸出老千
唇枪舌剑 偷走了宝典
花月夜 招蜂引蝶招惹谁
飘飘欲仙暗恋桃花源
光阴似箭流星蝴蝶剑
江湖老少年

天诛地灭 天杀的想念
杀手杀红了双眼
赶尽杀绝杀不死悬念
杀光风景杀时间
三头六臂 一手遮天
三十六计 溜走为先
七十二变 让子弹飞
天下无贼 最贼的是老天


老天有眼 一翻两瞪眼
岁月杀人不眨眼
人肉咸咸 人命不值钱
命运杀出杀手锏
一剑一剑 自己对决
一杯一杯 自己干杯
一圈一圈 自己作茧
一天一天 用昨天杀明天
tgt:
Dog eats dog, all crows under heaven are just as black
Ghosts make faces, petty men raise little ghosts
Spy versus spy, drip a few more eye drops
Crocodile tears, playing pitiful and delicate
Yin-yang demon realm, heaven is high and the emperor far away
Lust caution, ring caution, the hardest to quit is a lover
Beauties too beautiful, heroes will get too tired
Ill-fated love, self-made sin
Heaven destroys, earth extinguishes, damned missing you
The killer's eyes are bloodshot from killing
Wipe them all out, can't kill the suspense
Kill all the scenery, kill time
Three heads six arms, one hand covers the sky
Thirty-six stratagems, running away comes first
Seventy-two transformations, let the bullets fly
All is peaceful under heaven, the biggest thief is heaven

Snake and scorpion, colluding like wolves and jackals, cheating at cards
War of words, stole the treasured book
Flower moon night, attracting bees and butterflies, provoking whom
Floating like an immortal, secretly longing for the Peach Blossom Spring
Time flies like an arrow, meteor butterfly sword
An old youth in the martial world

Heaven destroys, earth extinguishes, damned missing you
The killer's eyes are bloodshot from killing
Wipe them all out, can't kill the suspense
Kill all the scenery, kill time
Three heads six arms, one hand covers the sky
Thirty-six stratagems, running away comes first
Seventy-two transformations, let the bullets fly
All is peaceful under heaven, the biggest thief is heaven


Heaven has eyes, one flip and both eyes stare
Time kills without blinking
Human flesh is salty, human life is worthless
Fate strikes with a killer move
One sword after another, dueling yourself
One cup after another, toasting yourself
One loop after another, spinning your own cocoon
One day after another, using yesterday to kill tomorrow

src:
圓吭高低唱，奇葩赤白章。
每嗟官束縛，肯放酒顛狂。
幕燕終難穩，池魚欲自藏。
宦游何處好，山北是吾鄉。
tgt:
With rounded throat, high and low I sing; rare blossoms in red and white bloom.
Each sigh at official bonds that bind, who would let wine's frenzy loose?
The swallow on the tent can never rest secure; the fish in the pond longs to hide itself away.
Where is the best place for an official's wanderings? North of the mountains is my home.

src:
徘徊銀穴送斜暉，散遣長鬚上翠微。
青鳥似知予意確，故傳仙語傍人飛。
tgt:
Lingering by the silver cave as the slanting sunbeams fade, I send my long-bearded companion up the verdant heights.
The blue bird seems to know my purpose is firm, so it carries immortal words, flying close to me.

src:
雪欲留君君不住，散作晴天送君去。
滄江破臘。
tgt:
Snow longs to keep you, but you cannot stay; it scatters into clear skies to send you on your way.
The cold-blue river breaks through the year's last month.

src:
松蘿影裏，積翠堆中。
白雲爲蓋，流泉作琴。
隻影獨標巖上月，不知那箇是知音。
耳卓朔，頭蓬鬆，擡眸鷂子過遼東。
tgt:
In the shadow of pine and moss, amid piled emerald hues.
White clouds serve as a canopy, flowing springs become a lute.
A lone figure stands out, the moon above the cliff, unknown who the true confidant is.
Ears erect and sharp, hair loose and wild, lifting eyes, a hawk crosses Liaodong.

src:
乌龙云洞，神护红尘外。
金鼎养丹砂，有仙卿、清修名世。
三千功行，活字少人知，松露閟，紫烟深，知是聃翁裔。
吹箫后约，岂慕穿青紫。
八十在人间，比当日、何须指李。
相逢一笑，酒量海同宽，拔宅隐，玉霄寒，升举应新岁。
tgt:
In the cave of black dragon clouds, the divine guards beyond the mortal dust.
In the golden cauldron, cinnabar is nourished; there is an immortal minister, renowned for pure cultivation.
Three thousand merits and deeds, few know the living words; pine dew is hidden, purple smoke is deep, knowing it is the descendant of Lao Dan.
After playing the flute, the promised meeting, how could one envy wearing blue and purple?
Eighty years in the human world, compared to that time, why need to point to Li.
Meeting with a smile, the capacity for wine is as broad as the sea; pulling up the house to hide, the jade sky is cold, ascension should be in the new year.

src:
鄰與鄒人卜，門歸太史評。
忽隨雙佩失，不見一珠成。
夢入清都杳，船維彼岸輕。
空餘江上月，依舊度窗明。
tgt:
A neighbor and a Zou man divined, the gate's return the Grand Historian appraised.
Suddenly with twin pendants lost, no single pearl seen formed.
Dream enters the clear capital far and faint, the boat moored at the other shore light.
In vain remains the moon over the river, still crossing the window bright.

src:
道人身名兩俱槁，道其所道非吾道。
橫江兩石作釣磯，不似嚴陵臺上好。
tgt:
The Daoist's body and name are both withered away, what he calls the Dao is not my Dao.
Two stones across the river serve as fishing rocks, not as fine as the Yanling Terrace.

src:
照眼驪珠光陸離，莆田太守寄新詩。
死生貴賤交情見，惟有吾宗不徇時。
tgt:
Dazzling pearls shine with a brilliant gleam, the Putian governor sends new poems.
In life and death, in honor and disgrace, true friendship shows; only our clan does not bend to the times.

src:
舟檝濟巨川，山河資秀氣。
服膺究儒業，屈指取高位。
北征戮驕悍，東守輯攜貳。
論道致巍巍，持衡無事事。
知己不易遇，宰相固有器。
瞻事華壁中，來者誰其嗣。
tgt:
A boat crosses the mighty river, mountains and streams lend their grace.
Embracing Confucian learning, counting on fingers to reach high rank.
Campaigning north to slay the arrogant and fierce, governing east to unite the divided.
Discoursing on the Way to reach the lofty, holding the balance with nothing to do.
A true confidant is hard to meet, a chancellor indeed has the capacity.
Gazing at the painted wall, who among those to come will succeed?

src:
济楚衣裳眉目秀。
活脱梨园，子弟家声旧。
诨砌随机开笑口。
筵前戏谏从来有。
戛玉敲金裁锦绣。
引得传情，恼得娇娥瘦。
离合悲欢成正偶。
明珠一颗盘中走。
tgt:
Your neat attire and handsome features shine.
Just like a stage player, born of an old theatrical line.
With witty impromptu lines, you open laughter's door.
Before the feast, jesting remonstrance has always been lore.
Your words ring like jade and gold, cut brocade fine.
You stir the heart with feeling, vex the fair maid till she pines.
Parting and reunion, joy and sorrow make the perfect pair.
A bright pearl rolls upon the tray with flair.

src:
豐年食少厭兒啼，覓得微官落五谿。
大似無家老禪衲，打包還度棧雲西。
tgt:
In a year of plenty, with little food, I tire of my child's crying; I found a minor post and settled by the Five Streams.
Much like an old Zen monk without a home,
Packing up, I cross once more west of the plank-road clouds.

src:
此扇拈來一羽輕，如何退得十千兵。
百年雨露蒙君賜，一日衣冠繫賊營。
正欲倒戈爲向背，遠觀揮手極分明。
而今但得旌旗白，便可中原取次行。
tgt:
This fan feels light as a single feather,
How could it repel ten thousand troops?
For a hundred years, I have received your grace like rain and dew,
One day, in official robes, I was bound in the rebel camp.
Just as I wished to turn my spear and choose my side,
From afar, I saw a waving hand with utmost clarity.
Now, if only the banners can be made white,
Then through the Central Plains, we may advance at will.

src:
鸞鶴共徘徊，仙官使者催。
香花三洞啓，風雨百神來。
鳳篆文初定，龍泥印已開。
何須生羽翼，始得上瑤臺。
tgt:
Phoenixes and cranes together linger and glide,
The immortal officials' envoys urge them on.
Incense and flowers open the Three Grottoes wide,
Through wind and rain a hundred gods have come.
The phoenix-script characters are just now set,
The dragon-clay seal has already been opened.
Why need one grow wings and feathers yet
Before one can ascend the Jade Terrace then?

src:
孤賤相長育，未曾爲遠遊。
誰不重歡愛，晨昏闕珍羞。
出門念衣車，草木當窮秋。
非疾有憂歎，實爲人子尤。
世情本難合，對面隔山丘。
況復干戈地，儒夫何所投。
與爾俱長成，尚爲溝壑憂。
豈非輕歲月，少小不勤修。
從今解思量，勉力謀善猷。
但得成爾身，衣食寧我求。
固合受此訓，墮慢爲身羞。
歲暮當歸來，慎莫懷遠遊。
tgt:
Grown up in humble circumstances, I've never traveled far.
Who doesn't value joyful love? Yet morning and night, delicacies are lacking.
Going out, I think of clothes and carriage; plants and trees face late autumn.
Not from illness come these sighs of worry—truly it is a son's fault.
The ways of the world are hard to fit; face to face, separated by hills.
How much more in a land of weapons—where can a scholar turn?
Having grown up together with you, still I worry about the ditches.
Is it not that I slight the years, not diligent in study from youth?
From now on I will think it over, strive to plan good counsel.
If only you can establish yourself, would I seek food and clothing for myself?
I should indeed accept this teaching; laziness would bring shame.
At year's end you must return—take care, do not cherish distant travels.

src:
一擊虛空成粉碎，渭川千畝亦徒勞。
不霑一點湘妃淚，自是無心節更高。
tgt:
One blow reduces all to dust; a thousand acres by River Wei would be in vain.
Unstained by even a single tear of the Xiang妃, it is all the more noble for having no heart.

src:
梵宮凭水建，蓬荻費芟除。
岸破群魚出，枝危獨鶴居。
定鐘僧睡早，揮麈客談虛。
月滿龕燈小，風停幡影疎。
供盤多佛菓，僧飯飽園蔬。
惟有開山老，清高閉草廬。
tgt:
A Brahma palace built by the waterside, with reeds and rushes cleared away with care.
The bank breaks, and a shoal of fish emerges; on a precarious branch, a solitary crane resides.
The fixed bell rings, and the monks sleep early; waving a whisk, the guest speaks of emptiness.
The moon is full, the shrine lamp is small; the wind stops, and the banner's shadow grows sparse.
Offering trays hold many Buddhist fruits; the monks' meal is satisfied with garden vegetables.
Only the founding elder, pure and lofty, keeps his thatched hut closed.

src:
門前秋水可揚舲，有意西尋白下亭。
只欲往來相邂逅，却嫌招喚苦丁寧。
tgt:
Before the gate, autumn waters can float a boat,
I mean to go west and seek the White Below Pavilion.
I only wish to come and go and meet by chance,
Yet I dislike the summons, so urgent and insistent.

src:
萬妃蕊珮影珊珊，沉水薰肌栗玉顔。
曾記廣寒宮裏見，誰移仙種下人間。
tgt:
The imperial concubine's jade pendants sway with a gentle grace, her skin perfumed with agarwood, her face fair as polished jade.
I once remember seeing her in the Guanghan Palace, who transplanted this immortal seed down to the mortal world?

src:
桂花香滿脩廊，皓月當空照我。
徐徐三弄瑶琴，恁地有何不可。
tgt:
Osmanthus fragrance fills the long corridor, the bright moon shines on me in the sky.
Slowly I play the jade zither three times, why should that not be fine?

src:
博而寡要豈通儒，三萬牙籤亦太虛。
一編論語用不盡，世間何必許多書。
tgt:
Broad but not essential—how can one be a true scholar? Thirty thousand ivory tags are also too empty.
One copy of the Analects is inexhaustible—why should the world need so many books?

src:
薄暮抱幽獨，無言倚小樓。
日沉千樹晚，風起一天秋。
警枕團新夢，寒衣带舊愁。
祇因吟太苦，餘病未全瘳。
tgt:
At dusk I embrace my solitude, wordless I lean on the small tower.
The sun sinks behind a thousand trees in the evening, the wind rises bringing autumn to the whole sky.
My alarm pillow gathers new dreams, my cold clothes carry old sorrows.
Only because I have chanted too bitterly, my lingering illness is not yet fully healed.

src:
老我甘投閒，晏然十三秋。
茲來何所似，反衣狐白裘。
京塵素爲緇，夢寐思首丘。
低徊未成去，黽勉終自羞。
久聞歌楚騷，欲見知無由。
詩文惠盈軸，一誦消百憂。
便當細論文，夜雨同春蒭。
平生萬事了，此去復何求。
尚貪未見書，痛洗千斛愁。
得此不翅足，携歸老先疇。
tgt:
In old age I willingly embrace leisure, peacefully through thirteen autumns.
What does this arrival resemble? Wearing a fox-fur robe inside out.
The capital's dust has always dyed things black, in dreams I long for my native hill.
Lingering, hesitating, I have not yet departed, forcing myself, ultimately ashamed.
Long have I heard songs of Chu Sao, wishing to meet but knowing no way.
Your poems and writings fill my axis, one recitation dissolves a hundred worries.
I should carefully discuss literature, together in night rain and spring fodder.
A lifetime's ten thousand matters are done, what more do I seek from this departure?
Still I covet unread books, painfully washing away a thousand gallons of sorrow.
Having this is more than enough, I'll carry it home to grow old on ancestral fields.

src:
休論吾昔與吾今，窗下婆娑有學林。
會意書非求甚解，無絃琴豈要知音。
是中截斷談天口，何處尋來立雪心。
永日春風鶑百囀，幽人踵息正深深。
tgt:
Say no more of my past and present, beneath the window, a scholarly grove sways.
Understanding a book doesn't require deep analysis; a stringless lute doesn't need a soulmate.
Here, the mouth that talks of heaven is cut off; where can one find the heart that stood in snow?
All day long, the spring breeze and a hundred warbling orioles; the recluse's heel-breath is deep and profound.

src:
海角地蒸雨，江南天要梅。
晚春知望久，中夏得愁開。
鬰鬰陰陰過，綿綿浩浩來。
已傳增米價，只道損苗栽。
tgt:
At the sea's edge, the earth steams with rain; in Jiangnan, the sky is about to bring plums.
Late spring knows I have waited long; by midsummer, sorrow can finally open.
Gloomy and overcast it passes; continuous and vast it comes.
Already it is said rice prices are rising; only talk is of damage to the seedlings.

src:
先生高寄此林泉，懶拙方知此樂全。
足屨兩忘便不借，人琴俱隠付無絃。
雲歸書帙留殘潤，日上香盤裊細烟。
勘破世紛無一事，又拈枯筆續前編。
tgt:
The gentleman lofty-minded dwells by this forest spring,
Only in laziness and clumsiness do I know this joy is complete.
Forgetting both feet and shoes, I simply go without borrowing,
Both man and lute hidden away, entrusted to a stringless tune.
Clouds return to the book scrolls, leaving lingering moisture,
The sun rises over the incense tray, curling fine smoke.
Having seen through the world's tangles, there is not one affair,
Again I pick up a dried brush to continue the previous volume.

src:
船泊邳州古岸傍，斜風細雨送昏黄。
美人十二船中坐，猶把金猊炷好香。
tgt:
The boat is moored beside the ancient bank of Pizhou,
In slanting wind and fine rain, dusk is seen off into yellow.
Twelve beauties sit within the boat,
Still tending golden lion incense, burning fine fragrance.

src:
霜林木葉未全紅，疎雨蕭蕭不滿空。
萬里黄花欺病眼，十年烏帽怯秋風。
可憐望遠身能健，愈覺追歡歲不同。
便欲題詩問鄉國，不堪回首失飛鴻。
tgt:
Frosted forest leaves are not yet fully red, sparse rain rustles, not filling the sky.
Ten thousand miles of yellow flowers offend my sick eyes, ten years of black hat fear the autumn wind.
Pitiful that gazing afar, my body can still be healthy, all the more I feel chasing joy, the years are not the same.
I want to inscribe a poem asking about my homeland, unbearable to look back, losing the flying swan.

src:
先生曰采薇山之巔兮，吾非求爲之仙。
吾無一畝之宅，一丘之田。
饑食山之薇，渴飲山之泉。
巖爲吾居兮，鹿爲吾馬。
吾豈不足兮，翺翔乎山之間。
彼世俗之混混兮，嗟苦短之白日。
此一身之悠悠兮，聊自樂以窮年。
彼塵埃之荏苒兮，此雲烟之綿聯。
誰謂才之大兮，慨匠氏之弗取。
吾獨幸其弗取兮，森葱蒼而自全。
粤吾君之爲治兮，三王之聖。
而吾相之爲輔兮，伊周之賢。
吾父吾母兮，皆善終以天算。
進何憂而退何憾兮，養吾氣之浩然。
弟子進而贊曰：采薇山之巔兮，其樂也如此。
衣曳曳而情飄飄兮，願執轡而往焉。
tgt:
The Master said: I gather ferns on the mountain's crest, not seeking to become immortal.
I have no plot of land, no acre for a home.
When hungry, I eat the mountain's ferns; when thirsty, I drink the mountain's spring.
The cliffs are my dwelling, the deer are my horses.
Am I not content, roaming among the mountains?
The worldly world is murky and confused; alas, the brief daylight is bitter short.
This single body drifts endlessly; I take my joy to pass the years.
Those dusts of the world shift and pass; these clouds and mists stretch on and on.
Who says talent is great? I sigh that the craftsman does not take it.
I alone am glad he does not take it, lush and verdant, preserving myself whole.
Our lord governs, sage as the three kings.
And our minister assists, worthy as Yi and Zhou.
My father and mother both passed with Heaven's span.
Advancing, what worry? Retreating, what regret? I nourish my vast and noble spirit.
The disciple steps forward and praises: On the mountain's crest gathering ferns, such is the joy.
Garments trailing, feelings floating, I wish to take the reins and go there.

src:
合去趨華闕，難教滯陋邦。
悲鳴憐老驥，迎吠厄羣龐。
便腹書千篋，濡頭酒一缸。
懷君夜不寐，落葉打空窗。
tgt:
Together we should go to the splendid palace gates,
How can I bear to linger in this humble land?
I pity the old steed that sadly neighs,
And face the barking of a hostile pack.
My well-fed belly holds a thousand books,
My soaked head, a jar of wine.
Thinking of you, I lie awake all night,
While fallen leaves tap on the empty window.

src:
乘夕棹歸舟，緣源路轉幽。
月明看嶺樹，風靜聽溪流。
嵐氣船間入，霜華衣上浮。
猿聲雖此夜，不是別家愁。
tgt:
Rowing homeward by evening boat, along the source the path turns secluded.
In the bright moonlight I see the ridge trees, in the still wind I hear the stream flow.
Mountain mist enters between the boat, frost flowers float upon my clothes.
Though there are gibbon cries on this night, it is not the sorrow of parting from home.

src:
白髮非有種，如何忽自生。
盡從方寸地，蒔此兩三莖。
場屋債猶欠，山林計未成。
頭顱知漸醜，羞向鏡中呈。
tgt:
White hair has no seed, how does it suddenly grow?
All from within this square inch of heart, I plant these two or three stems.
Debts to the examination hall still unpaid, plans for mountains and forests not yet fulfilled.
My head, I know, grows uglier by degrees—ashamed to show itself in the mirror.

src:
春江足風雨，雨裏送江行。
黄綬我白下，絃歌翁武城。
題輿適茲地，捧檄重相并。
邂逅得兄弟，從遊成友生。
臨分皆有贈，雖病可忘情。
中壘經窮旨，建安詩著名。
絕知傳世遠，可但决科榮。
江右連江左，相期茂厥聲。
tgt:
Spring river swells with wind and rain, in the rain I see you off along the river.
With yellow ribbon I serve at Baixia, you bring strings and songs to Wucheng.
Inscribing carriage we arrive at this place, holding summons we reunite again.
By chance we become brothers, in companionship we grow as friends.
At parting each has gifts to give, though ill, how can affection be forgotten.
The Central Camp exhausts the classic's meaning, Jian'an poetry earns its fame.
Surely we know its transmission spans far generations, how could it be but glory in passing exams.
Jiangxi connects to Jiangdong, we pledge to make our names flourish.

src:
洶洶瀾無際，滔滔勢欲東。
百川容莫量，三島杳難窮。
天淡祠堂古，雲低客路通。
暫來回首懶，歸轡逐西風。

久矣鴻飛渚，翩然鴈字峯。
九重疏異渥，萬里合幽封。
引柩烏銜壤，馴阡鹿護松。
他時人下馬，有子是夔龍。
tgt:
Long has the swan flown from the isle, soaring in wild-goose formation to the peak.
Nine layers of heaven bestow uncommon grace, ten thousand miles join in a hidden seal.
Drawing the coffin, crows carry earth; taming the paths, deer guard the pines.
In time to come, people will dismount from their horses—you have a son who is a Kui or a Long.

src:
朝看雨脚似懸繩，暮見寬波沒釣汀。
鴨鴨歸來人寂寂，鴉鴉飛去草青青。

夢草池邊一笑同，冥冥雲迹羡飛鴻。
青山不屬紅蓮客，黄菊羞簪白髪翁。
直使淮南叛謀寝，未妨冀北馬羣空。
中興事業須公等，勿憚危言達聖聰。
tgt:
Beside the Dream-Grass Pool we shared a smile, same as before,
I envy the wild geese that trace their unseen paths through cloud and sky.
Green mountains do not belong to the red-lotus guest,
Yellow chrysanthemums shame to pin on a white-haired old man.
Even if this makes Huainan's rebellious schemes lie dormant,
It does not prevent the horse herds of Jibei from being emptied.
The cause of restoration requires men like you,
Do not fear to speak bold words that reach the sage's ear.

src:
久居朝蹟遲遷次，雖在琴齋頗寂寥。
交少自應無援拔，地寒安得有肥饒。
桃花落處春風緊，梅蘂開時臘雪銷。
畢竟徐行能遠到，樽前贏得且逍遥。
tgt:
Long dwelling in court ranks, slow to advance in station, though in my lute studio, quite solitary.
With few connections, naturally I have no one to pull me up; in a cold place, how could there be richness and plenty?
Where peach blossoms fall, the spring wind blows fierce; when plum buds open, the twelfth-month snow melts away.
After all, walking slowly can reach far; before the wine cup, I win the chance to be free and at ease.

src:
月娥新琢玉，何夕忽遺簪。
斜插風鬟濕，蟾宮底處尋。
tgt:
The moon goddess has newly carved jade; on what night did she suddenly lose her hairpin?
Aslant it was stuck in her damp wind-blown hair; where in the toad palace can it be found?

src:
扣門衲子誦詩聲，雙脚行纒拄杖輕。
何處參同得消息，便能作句吐新清。
高僧著意遊湖海，逐客從誰匿姓名。
試聽窟中獅子吼，未應斷盡野牛鳴。
tgt:
A knock at the gate—the monk recites a poem,
His feet wrapped in cloth, his staff light in hand.
Where can one find the news of shared understanding?
Then one can craft lines that breathe fresh and clear.
The eminent monk sets his mind on roaming lakes and seas,
The exiled wanderer—from whom can he hide his name?
Listen closely to the lion's roar from the cave—
It should not have silenced the wild ox's lowing.

src:
江上提魚婦，朝朝入市闉。
守船留稚子，換酒醉良人。
不著凌波襪，長垂濺水裙。
渾家同泛客，笑殺別離津。
tgt:
The fisherwoman on the river, to the market goes each day.
She leaves her child to mind the boat, and buys wine with her pay.
No silken socks upon her feet, her skirt trails in the tide.
With family aboard, she laughs at those who part the riverside.

src:
潇洒幽居，溪园上、新来卜筑。
况自有、一泓流水，万竿修竹。
屈指花朝才两夜，祥烟瑞气腾芳郁。
问辽空、何物堕人间，长庚宿。
薰宝鸭，烧银烛。
歌窈窕，倾醽醁。
愿年年常恁，颜红鬓绿。
长厚而为难老本，慈仁便是长生箓。
看芝兰、玉树早蜚英，青毡复。
tgt:
Free and secluded I dwell, by the creek and garden, newly built.
Moreover, there is a stream of flowing water, ten thousand bamboo poles slender.
Counting on my fingers, the Flower Morning is but two nights away, auspicious smoke and propitious air rise fragrant and dense.
I ask the vast sky, what has fallen into the mortal world—the Long Geng star.
Incense burns in the precious duck-shaped censer, silver candles are lit.
Singing of graceful beauty, pouring the fine wine.
Wishing year after year to always be like this, rosy face and dark green hair.
Being generous and kind is the foundation for a long life, compassion and benevolence are the register of longevity.
See the orchids and jade trees early spreading their splendor, the blue felt restored.

src:
誰遣參軍阨所長，夜聽鈴鼓度修廊。
風流偶未逢狂客，歌頌空驚逼漫郎。
莫恨驊騮縻皁櫪，要令松柏飽冰霜。
如聞委吏真勞擾，不許歸田是孔方。
tgt:
Who sent the aide to a place where his talents are thwarted, at night he listens to bells and drums passing through the long corridor.
Elegant and unrestrained, by chance he has not met a wild guest, his songs and praises vainly startle and press upon the wandering man.
Do not resent that the fine steed is tethered in the stable, one must let the pines and cypresses be filled with ice and frost.
As if hearing that the petty official is truly troubled and disturbed, what does not allow him to return to the fields is money.

src:
小齋標新名，清風自成響。
世累已破除，陽來道方長。

秋堂留曉客，密雨擁柴門。
石鼎燃松葉，山樽捧竹根。
買魚催網急，嘗栗破皺繁。
村黑歸泥滑，移床醉夜軒。
tgt:
Autumn hall keeps the dawn guest; dense rain crowds the brushwood gate.
A stone tripod burns pine leaves; a mountain cup holds bamboo roots.
Buying fish, they urge the nets swiftly; tasting chestnuts, they split the wrinkled clusters.
The village is dark, the return mud slippery; they move the couch, drunk in the night chamber.

src:
琉璃地上開紅豔，碧落天頭散曉霞。
應是向西無地種，不然爭肯重蓮花。
tgt:
On glazed ground bloom red blossoms bright,
Across the azure sky dawn clouds spread light.
There must be no land westward where they could grow,
Else why would they choose to bloom as lotus here below.

src:
花紅柳綠菩提相，燕語鶑啼般若宗。
更去補陀山上覓，雲濤煙浪捲天風。
tgt:
Red blooms and green willows show the Bodhi's face,
Swallows twitter and orioles sing the Prajna's trace.
Go further to seek on Mount Potalaka's height,
Where cloud waves and misty billows roll up the wind of the sky.

src:
三分香有七分清，月冷霜寒太瘦生。
山澤之儒君識否，樂天姓氏謫僊名。
tgt:
Three parts fragrance, seven parts clarity, too thin beneath the cold moon and frost.
Do you know the scholar of the mountains and marshes? His surname is Letian, his name Exiled Immortal.

src:
壽康朝謁蚤，長信燕閒多。
不有圖書樂，其如晝漏何。
tgt:
At Shoukang, morning audiences come early;
In Changxin, leisure is plentiful.
Without the joy of books and paintings,
How could one bear the daylight hours?

src:
吾州斗大城，辛丑爇於火。
予時年十五，天地一蜾蠃。
竄身城北門，尚憶雙髻鬌。
秋暑七月半，洶湧沸炎堁。
日午饑無食，枝頭得梨果。
不謂心尚孩，析薪未克荷。
先君儒起家，負冤踣奔播。
赭垣獲苟免，小宅亦云頗。
先祖之舊居，竟弗脫此禍。
二三叔父家，貲産素不夥。
焚如既已酷，生理各坎軻。
老者漸喪亡，頼嘗教敕我。
田屋悉破散，江湖走一舸。
掇科敭歷久，身幸青紫裹。
中年營一區，稍於己意可。
紫陽正面南，烏聊在其左。
前榮藝花木，後圃蒔菜蓏。
軍興盜賊起，萬卷破甑墮。
乙未九月災，天特赦么麽。
巋然七十翁，吾其理歸柁。
tgt:
My state's city was the size of a bushel, in the Xinchou year it burned in fire.
I was fifteen years old then, in heaven and earth like a solitary wasp.
I fled to the north gate of the city, still remembering my twin hair buns.
Autumn heat at mid-July, surging and boiling with fiery dust.
At noon hungry with no food, I found pear fruit on the branches.
Little did I think my heart was still childish, splitting firewood I could not yet bear.
My late father rose from a Confucian family, bearing injustice he fell and wandered.
From the red walls I barely escaped, a small dwelling was also quite something.
My ancestors' old residence, in the end could not escape this calamity.
Two or three uncles' homes, their property was never much.
Burned as it was already cruel, their livelihoods each met with hardship.
The elderly gradually passed away, relying on them I was once taught and admonished.
Fields and houses all broken and scattered, I roamed rivers and lakes in a single boat.
Gathering examination honors and rising through ranks for long, my body fortunately wrapped in blue and purple.
In middle age I built a plot, somewhat to my own liking.
Ziyang faces south directly, Wu Liao is on its left.
In the front courtyard I planted flowers and trees, in the back garden I sowed vegetables and melons.
When war arose and bandits rose, ten thousand volumes fell like a broken steamer.
In the ninth month of the Yiwei year disaster came, heaven specially pardoned this tiny one.
Towering at seventy years old, I shall now steer my course home.

src:
老農含笑指家丁，偃伯靈臺始見生。
身手只今大如許，耳根不識鼓鼙聲。
tgt:
The old farmer smiles and points to his household men; at the Ling Terrace, Lord Yan first sees life.
His skill and strength are only now this great; his ears have never known the sound of drums and war.

src:
世事無窮似弈棋，不如常采故山芝。
蕭蕭雞犬三家聚，莽莽風烟十里陂。
幸有濁醪從客醉，常憂黠鬼笑人癡。
清秋樂處君知否，庭下幽花漸可移。
tgt:
The affairs of the world are endless like a game of chess, better to often gather the mushrooms of my old mountain.
With rustling chickens and dogs, three families gather, vast and wild, wind and mist over ten miles of slope.
Fortunately, there is cloudy wine to get drunk with guests, always worried that cunning ghosts laugh at human foolishness.
Do you know the joy of clear autumn? In the courtyard, the secluded flowers can gradually be moved.

src:
舌頭肉一臠，口唇皮兩片。
有時說道談禪，忽地轟雷掣電。
萬機影銷，一色功轉。
本來無物鏡非臺，胡漢不痕何所見。
tgt:
A morsel of tongue flesh, two flaps of lip skin.
Sometimes speaking of Zen, suddenly thunder and lightning.
Ten thousand machinations vanish, one pure color turns.
Originally nothing exists, the mirror is not a stand; with no trace of barbarian or Han, what is there to see?

src:
冤有頭，債有主，撞破砂盆眼卓豎。
不是佛，不是祖，太白峯前只如許。
tgt:
When there's a wrong, there's a debtor; when the basin is smashed, the eyes stand upright.
Not a Buddha, not a patriarch; before Taibai Peak, it is just like this.

src:
在地在山無不可，去年今年同不同。
銀杯縞带逐車馬，何似蓑笠隨漁翁。
tgt:
On land or in the mountains, either will do; last year and this year, are they the same or not?
With silver cups and white belts, chasing carriages and horses, how does that compare to following a fisherman with a straw cloak and hat?

src:
天作高山太王荒，鸑鷟一鳴周翦商。
郟鄏卜年大蒐講，諸侯歛衽尊天王。
六月中興繩祖武，平蕩犬戎恢境土。
石崖可鑿詩可鎸，千載神光薄西滸。
橐駝輓入大梁都，璧水湛湛河出圖。
中間兩鼓備章句，日惟丙申不模糊。
左驂秀弓射麋豕，有鰟有□君子漁。
光和石經屹相望，詛楚登嶧非吾徒。
辛壬癸甲雁分翅，橋門觀者堵牆如。
星沉東壁干戈起，首下足上天倒置。
景鐘糜碎九鼎飛，王迹皇風吁掃地。
羣胡扛石徙幽燕，兵車亂載包無氈。
敲火礪角小小爾，爲礎爲砧多歷年。
宣和殿中圖復古，冠以車攻次十鼓。
韓詩歐跋盡兼收，雲章剖判定魚魯。
先君辛苦朔方歸，文犀拱璧棄弗携。
一編十襲自鐍祕，更有司馬鳳翔碑。
我生不辰今已老，岐陽三雍身不到。
匆匆使虜接淅行，在耶亡耶問無報。
整齊篆籀飾牙籤，簡撮篇詠勞窮探。
致主有心歌小雅，汗顔無術下登三。
tgt:
Heaven made the lofty mountains, Tai Wang opened them wide,
A phoenix's single cry, Zhou cut down Shang in its pride.
At Jia Ru divined the years, great hunts were held with care,
The feudal lords bowed low, the Heavenly King to revere.
In mid-sixth month revival came, ancestral martial ways,
They crushed the Quanrong tribes and restored the frontier's lays.
The stone cliffs could be carved, the poems could be engraved,
For a thousand years divine light spread where western waters waved.
Camels hauled them to the great Liang capital's domain,
Where the Bi Pool shimmered clear, the River gave its chart again.
Between them two drums complete the lines of every phrase,
On the day of Bing-Shen, not a word is lost in haze.
The left team's bowmen shot the elk and swine with skill,
There were bream and there were—, the gentleman fished his fill.
Guanghe stone classics stand in solemn facing rows,
The curse on Chu, the ascent of Yi—not my comrades' blows.
Xin, Ren, Gui, Jia, the wild geese part their wings in flight,
At the bridge gate onlookers pressed like a wall of tight.
The star sank in the eastern wall, then spears and wars arose,
Heads down, feet up, the world was turned against its foes.
The Jing Bell shattered, the Nine Tripods flew away,
The kingly traces, imperial wind—alas, swept away.
The barbarian hordes hauled the stones to You and Yan,
War chariots in chaos bore them, wrapped with no felt span.
Striking fire, whetting horns—small matters, trifling things,
As foundation stones and anvils they served through many springs.
In the Xuanhe Hall, pictures sought the ancient way,
Topped with "Chariot Attack," then the Ten Drums in array.
Han's poems, Ou's colophons—all gathered and combined,
Cloud-like chapters judged and settled, fish and Lu defined.
My late father toiled and came back from the northern land,
Rhino horn and jade discs he cast aside from hand.
A single volume, tenfold wrapped, locked and kept in secret trust,
And more—the Sima Fengxiang stele, covered in dust.
I was born in an unlucky hour, and now I am old,
Qiyang's three halls—my body never reached their hold.
In haste I go as envoy to the foe, like washing rice in flight,
Whether I live or die, no answer comes to light.
I arrange the seal and scribe scripts, adorn them with ivory tags,
Collecting brief odes and songs, searching with weary legs.
To serve my lord I have the heart to sing the Minor Odes' strain,
But blush with shame—no skill to reach the highest three's domain.

src:
鵲結巢隨太歲移，蜂分房占吉時飛。
好將說與青臺史，社日祇憑燕子歸。
tgt:
The magpie builds its nest and moves with the years of Jupiter,
The bees divide their hive and fly at auspicious times.
It is well to tell this to the historian of the green terrace,
On the day of the earth god, one relies only on the swallows' return.

src:
回翔青瑣已多時，四海歸榮更是誰。
通籍禁中參鳳閣，司言天上煥龍墀。
修文禮樂源何大，振筆雲雷澤益滋。
若把王褒頌勳業，未如際會遇昌期。
tgt:
Having soared through the green gates for many a year, who else returns in glory from the four seas?
With name enrolled in the palace, he joins the Phoenix Pavilion; speaking for Heaven, he brightens the Dragon Stairs.
How vast the source of culture, rites, and music; wielding the brush like cloud and thunder, his grace grows ever more.
If one compares Wang Bao's praise of meritorious deeds, it cannot match meeting such a prosperous age.

src:
樓影搖波到碧空，拒霜無數隔堤紅。
只應明夜關山月，憐我相思不寐中。
tgt:
Tower shadows sway on waves to the blue sky,
Countless hibiscus bloom red along the dike.
Only the moon over mountain pass tomorrow night
Would pity me, lovesick, awake in the night.

src:
烟含疏柳綠蒙茸，杏頰桃英入眼紅。
邂逅與君逢臘雪，飄零獨我過春風。
空愁轉轂音塵遠，且寄離懷笑語中。
後夜月明人寂寂，相思那復一樽同。

城隅勞心處，雪後歲芳開。
山暎千花出，泉經萬井來。
翔鸞欲下舞，上客且留杯。
tgt:
At the city corner where my heart toils, after snow the year's fragrance blooms.
Mountains reflect a thousand flowers emerging, springs flow through ten thousand wells.
Soaring phoenixes about to descend and dance, honored guests, stay and keep your cups.

src:
桃花新綠漲溪橋，楊柳傞傞弄舞腰。
二月不堪寒尚在，一春無那病相撩。
書編讀半懶重讀，爐籀燒殘欣復燒。
老向人間除妄想，但思混迹向漁樵。
tgt:
Peach blossoms' new green swell the creek bridge, willows sway with dancing waists.
In the second month, the cold lingers unbearably; all spring, illness teases without cease.
Half-read books, too lazy to read again; incense burned low, gladly lit once more.
Aged among the world, I cast off vain desires, only longing to blend among fishermen and woodcutters.

src:
君不見，鷲峰勝集，百萬茫茫等閑過，壞衲之外皆清墮。
君又不見，熊嶺孤運，歲月索索艱難生，深雪之中有一箇。
宛轉流落千餘年，危分嶮布空平闐。
弁龍蛇兮眼何正，擒虎兕兮機不全。
石窗四顧滄溟窄，寥寥不許白雲白。
掣斷金鎖天麒麟，高舉鐵鞭擊三百。
猶輕舍，争知也，别有七星光鬭射。
風前把欲贈行人，將報不平遶天下。
tgt:
Do you not see, on Vulture Peak the grand assembly, a million vast multitudes passed by idly, beyond the worn robe all were pure and fallen.
Do you not again see, on Bear Ridge the lone practice, years and months bleak and hard was life born, within deep snow there was one.
Winding and wandering adrift for over a thousand years, perilously divided and steeply spread, empty and level filled.
Discern dragons and serpents, how upright are the eyes, capture tigers and rhinos, yet the mechanism is not complete.
Stone window looks around, the vast sea is narrow, so sparse it does not allow white clouds to be white.
Pull and break the golden lock, the heavenly qilin, raise high the iron whip and strike three hundred.
Still lightly relinquish, how to know, there is another seven-star radiance fighting and shooting.
Before the wind, hold it wanting to gift to the traveler, will repay injustice around the whole world.

src:
紛紛俗事起如毛，病起南窗厭作勞。
正欲往來求飯飽，敢將辛苦治名高。
長閑似稱三冬卧，舊學虚蒙一字褒。
他日相逢有餘地，尚容衰晚鬬堅牢。
tgt:
The trivial affairs of the world rise like hairs, after illness I rise from the south window, weary of toil.
Just as I wish to come and go seeking to fill my belly, how dare I take hardship to cultivate a high reputation.
Long leisure seems to suit lying in bed through the three winter months, my old learning vainly receives a single word of praise.
If one day we meet and there is room to spare, still allow my declining years to fight on sturdy and strong.

src:
誰謂貧難忍，三年閉戶居。
老兵能合藥，小僕會抄書。
白髮羞彈鋏，青山去荷鉏。
既於吟得趣，功業合乘除。
tgt:
Who says poverty is hard to bear, three years living behind closed doors.
An old soldier can mix medicines, a young servant knows how to copy books.
White hair, ashamed to drum the sword hilt, to green mountains, going to shoulder a hoe.
Since in chanting I find delight, merit and career should be weighed and divided.

src:
異論縱橫害已深，一言性善發天心。
民彝物則依然定，多少綱常起獸禽。
tgt:
Dissent runs rampant, causing deep harm; one word that human nature is good reveals the heart of Heaven.
The people's norms and things' principles remain settled; how many moral bonds arise from beasts and birds.

src:
維古修竹鄉，君子世此居。
厥壤既宜竹，種竹環其廬。
根不取馬箠，笋不供盤蔬。
永保歲寒盟，子孫樂只且。
老夫何當曳長裾，一窺旌節舊門閭。
華亭豈羨揚州鶴，松江自足馮驩魚。
田園伏臘頗有餘，竹中明燈夜讀書。
tgt:
In the ancient land of fine bamboo, a gentleman has lived for generations.
The soil is suited to bamboo, which surrounds his dwelling.
Its roots are not cut for horse whips, its shoots not served as dishes.
Forever keeping the cold-season vow, descendants rejoice.
When can this old man trail his long robe, to glimpse the old gate of banners and staffs?
Why envy the Yangzhou crane at Huating, when Songjiang has fish enough for Feng Huan?
The fields and garden provide plenty for winter and summer sacrifices; in the bamboo, a bright lamp reads books at night.

src:
中川累石勢嵯峩，城上遥岑聳翠螺。
舊說夕陽無限好，此中最得夕陽多。
tgt:
The Zhongchuan River piles stones into towering peaks,
Above the city, distant hills rise like green spiral shells.
An old saying goes: the setting sun is infinitely lovely,
And here, of all places, one savors the most of its glow.

src:
西原陰接樹，東浦暝沉籬。
月落溪沙走，星飛岸柳移。
鮮螢縈淺草，幽鳥擇深枝。
背水中宵坐，愁多病莫支。

仙蹕初傳紫禁香，瑞雲開處夜花芳。
繁弦促管升平調，綺綴丹蓮借月光。
tgt:
The immortal's footsteps first spread fragrance through the purple forbidden city,
Where auspicious clouds part, night flowers are fragrant.
Busy strings and urgent pipes rise in peaceful tunes,
Gorgeous ornaments and red lotuses borrow the moonlight.

src:
新學琵琶曲破成，仙韶第一已知名。
朱絃未落黄金撥，玉腕先聞動釧聲。
tgt:
The new tune on the pipa is now complete,
The first in the immortal music, renowned.
Before the red strings fall to the golden plectrum,
Her jade wrist is heard moving with the sound of bracelets.

src:
衡門秋到總堪悲，荷折蒲荒不整齊。
但喜風前無立豹，亦知砌下有蹲鴟。
吾徒老矣成何事，生理茫然更久稽。
清凈無風天雨已，山前山後且扶藜。
tgt:
When autumn reaches the simple gate, it's always sad; lotus and reed are withered and in disarray.
But I am glad there is no standing leopard in the wind, and I also know beneath the steps there is a squatting owl.
We, my followers, have grown old—what have we accomplished? Our livelihood is vague and delayed even longer.
Pure and quiet, no wind, the sky's rain has stopped; before and behind the mountain, for now, I lean on my staff.

src:
雒陽客，後車結駟傳燭食，人生富貴不易得。
江頭秋風旦夕起，胡爲翩翩雒陽陌。
雒陽陌，吹塵埃。
江頭樹，安在哉。
秋風起，菱花開。
鱸魚肥，歸去來。
tgt:
A guest in Luoyang, with four-horse carriage and candles for meals, wealth and honor in life are not easy to attain.
By the river's head, autumn winds rise morning and evening; why so lightly wander the Luoyang paths?
The Luoyang paths, blow dust and dirt.
The trees by the river's head, where are they now?
Autumn winds rise, water chestnut flowers bloom.
Perch are fat, return home.

src:
用人論理見宸衷，賞罰刑威合至公。
天下監司二千石，姓名都在御屏中。
tgt:
By human principles, the emperor's mind is seen,
Rewards and punishments, strict justice, all serene.
Throughout the land, officials high and low,
Their names are all within the imperial screen.

src:
明窗短壁拂蛛絲，常是江邉送客時。
留滯錦城生白髮，不如巢燕有歸期。
tgt:
Through the clear window and short wall, I brush away cobwebs,
Often by the riverside when seeing guests off.
Lingering in the Brocade City, white hair grows,
Not like the nesting swallows that have a time to return.

src:
涼霄煙靄外，三五玉蟾秋。
列野星辰正，當空鬼魅愁。
泉澄寒魄瑩，露滴冷光浮。
未折青青桂，吟看不忍休。
tgt:
Beyond the mist and smoke of the chilly night,
The autumn moon shines like a jade toad bright.
The stars are ranged in order in the sky;
The ghosts and goblins grieve as they pass by.
The cold moon's soul is crystal-clear in the spring;
Its floating light is chilled by dew-dropping.
I would not pluck the green osmanthus tree,
But gaze and gaze and can't bear to leave it free.

src:
刺舉官猶屈，風謠政已成。
行看換龜組，奏最謁承明。
tgt:
Though still a low-ranking official, his governance has already borne fruit in songs and ballads.
Soon he will exchange his turtle-shell seal for a new ribbon, and present his achievements at the Chengming Hall.

src:
泉聲㶁㶁樹蒼蒼，云有高僧占一房。
糧絕罕曾起烟火，佛來不肯下禪床。
緇流誰可傳宗旨，黄敕難招坐道場。
何必真分一間住，偶爲但過亦清凉。
tgt:
The spring murmurs and trees are lush green, they say a great monk occupies a room.
Food run out, he rarely ever lights a fire; even Buddha comes, he won't leave his meditation bed.
Among the monks, who can pass on the doctrine's core? An imperial edict struggles to summon him to sit at the dharma ground.
Why must one truly be allotted a room to stay? A chance passing visit is also cool and refreshing.

src:
仙翁曾播植，瓊圃尚敷榮。
春日祥光滿，秋風瑞實成。
黃精宜益壽，萱草足忘情。
候採靈芝服，還應羽翼生。
（同前。
）（〖1〗《洞霄圖志》卷四《古跡門·藥圃》條：「藥圃，在來賢巖宜霜亭下，夏侯天師種藥於此。
芝畦校塢，百藥之植，靡所不有。
常施藥於廛市，隨緣深淺而與之。
一日，樵者聞圃內有物大噑，隔籬窺見天師，策鞭乘一獸，似虎非虎，行疾如風，入東山而去。
今四山產藥草六十餘種，圃跡猶存。
」）。
tgt:
The immortal sage once planted here, the jade garden still blooms in glory.
Spring days are filled with auspicious light, autumn winds bring the ripened fruit.
Polygonatum is good for prolonging life, daylily is enough to forget worries.
When the time comes, gather the magic mushrooms to eat, and feathers and wings should grow.
(As before.)
(〖1〗 "Dongxiao Tuzhi" Volume 4, "Ancient Sites·Medicine Garden" entry: "The Medicine Garden is below Yishuang Pavilion at Laixian Rock, where Master Xia Hou planted medicines.
With mushroom beds and embankments, all kinds of herbs were planted, nothing was absent.
He often gave medicine in the marketplace, dispensing according to the depth of fate.
One day, a woodcutter heard a great roar in the garden, and peering through the fence saw the Master, whip in hand, riding a beast, like a tiger but not a tiger, moving as fast as the wind, heading into the Eastern Mountain.
Today, over sixty kinds of medicinal herbs grow on the four mountains, and the traces of the garden still remain.")

src:
一百五日又欲來，梨花梅花參差開。
行人自笑不歸去，瘦馬獨吟真可哀。
杏酪漸香鄰舍粥，榆煙將變舊爐灰。
畫橋春煖清歌夜，肯信愁腸日九迴。
tgt:
On the hundred-and-fifth day it will come again,
Pear blossoms and plum blossoms open uneven.
The traveler laughs at himself, not returning home,
A thin horse neighs alone—truly pitiful.
Apricot porridge gradually fragrant, the neighbor's gruel,
Elm smoke about to turn to old stove ashes.
By the painted bridge, warm spring night, clear songs,
Who would believe the sorrowful heart turns nine times a day.

src:
朝憎鶯百囀，夜妒燕雙棲。
不慣經春別，誰知到曉啼。
tgt:
At dawn I hate the oriole's hundred trills,
At night I envy swallows nesting in pairs.
Unused to parting in the spring,
Who knows I weep until the dawn?

src:
廬岳東南秀，香花惠遠蹤。
名齊松嶺峻，氣比沃州濃。
積岫連何處，幽崖越幾重。
雙流湓隱隱，九派棹憧憧。
山限東西寺，林交旦暮鐘。
半天傾瀑溜，數郡見鑪峰。
巖竝金繩道，潭分玉像容。
江微匡俗路，日杲晉朝松。
椶逕新苞拆，梅籬故葉壅。
嵐光生疊砌，霞焰發高墉。
窗籟虛聞狖，庭煙黑過龍。
定僧仙嶠起，逋客虎溪逢。
濩落垂楊戶，荒涼種杏封。
塔留紅舍利，池吐白芙蓉。
畫壁披雲見，禪衣對鶴縫。
喧經泉滴瀝，沒履草丰茸。
翠竇欹攀乳，苔橋側杖筇。
探奇盈夢想，搜峭滌心胸。
冥奧終難盡，登臨惜未從。
上方薇蕨滿，歸去養乖慵。
tgt:
Southeast of Mount Lu lies its beauty, fragrant flowers trace Huiyuan's past.
Its fame rivals the steep Pine Ridge, its spirit richer than Wozhou's.
Where do the layered peaks lead, past how many hidden cliffs?
Two streams flow faintly at Pen, nine branches of boats in confusion.
The mountain divides the east and west temples, forests exchange bells of dawn and dusk.
Half the sky pours down waterfalls, several counties see the Furnace Peak.
Cliffs align with the golden rope path, pools mirror the jade image's face.
The river faintly shows Kuangsu's road, the sun bright on Jin dynasty pines.
Palm paths where new buds burst, plum fences where old leaves pile.
Mountain mist rises on layered steps, sunset flames burst from high walls.
By the window, faint cries of monkeys, courtyard smoke black as passing dragons.
Meditating monks rise on immortal peaks, wanderers meet at Tiger Stream.
Desolate, weeping willows at the door, deserted, apricot trees enclosed.
The pagoda keeps red relics, the pond spits white lotuses.
Murals part the clouds to see, Zen robes sewn facing cranes.
Noisy sutras, dripping springs, shoes sunk in lush grass.
Green caves tilt with climbing breasts, mossy bridges slant with bamboo staffs.
Seeking wonders fills dreams, searching cliffs cleanses the heart.
The hidden depths are endless, regretting not to climb and follow.
Above, ferns and violets fill, return to nourish a lazy idleness.

src:
瀏陽吾未到，疇昔到長沙。
文定諸胡子，宣公故相□。
□□□已化，心皎月無瑕。
□□尋方冊，燈昏眼易花。
tgt:
I have never been to Liuyang, but once I went to Changsha.
The Hu family of Wending, the former minister of Xuangong.
□□□ has already transformed, the heart is as bright as the moon without flaw.
□□ seeking the square books, the lamp is dim and the eyes easily blur.

src:
郡大當塗古，分符得少蓬。
威如烏府在，令與繡衣同。
鈴閣紬書外，花村賣劍中。
少需撫摩意，來作玉堂翁。
tgt:
The ancient commandery of Dangtu is grand, where one receives a warrant and gains a young Peng.
Authority like that of the Censorate remains, orders are the same as those of the embroidered-clad official.
Beyond the bell tower and the silk documents, in the flower village where swords are sold.
A little patience to soothe the mind, coming to become the old man of the Jade Hall.

src:
先以下爲基，終當保不危。
泰山雄地鎮，北斗正天維。
敏手誇能賦，忠言願聽卑。
百常登觀闕，九仞揭旌旗。
木有遷鶑集，墉惟射隼宜。
舉家何氏隠，雙下李愔搥。
大比楊雄好，長同巽卦爲。
巍然望堯帝，卓爾仰宣尼。
羊肆猶陳義，皇墳或媲詞。
變更驚岸谷，豐稔閱京坻。
醉枕日三丈，詞場桂一枝。
金城橫絕險，龍馬出權奇。
已著名僧傳，仍先國手棋。
張弓聊抑爾，封岱更增之。
郢曲故難和，牙琴誰復知。
楩柟凌遠壑，鴻鵠漾晴曦。
漢祖興邦日，商宗享國時。
設科求德劭，巡狩問年耆。
容駟開門戶，摩霄展羽儀。
形容上麟閣，勳閥照鰲碑。
密勿雲臺議，揄揚崧嶽詩。
巖巖具瞻峻，那復嘆隆墀。
tgt:
Start with the foundation below, and in the end you will surely remain safe from danger.
Mount Tai majestically secures the earth; the Big Dipper aligns the celestial order.
With nimble hands, one boasts the ability to compose; loyal words are willing to be heard by the lowly.
Ascending the watchtower a hundred times, raising banners ninety ren high.
Trees attract migrating orioles to gather; the city wall is fit for shooting falcons.
The whole family hides like the He clan; both fall like Li Yin's pounding.
Greatly surpassing Yang Xiong is good; long together with the Xun hexagram as one.
Majestically gazing toward Emperor Yao, eminently looking up to Confucius.
Even in the sheep market, righteousness is still displayed; the imperial tombs may match the words.
Changes startle the riverbanks and valleys; abundant harvests are seen in the capital and mounds.
Drunk on a pillow for three zhang of sun, in the field of words, a single cassia branch.
The metal city spans the most perilous pass; dragon horses emerge with rare excellence.
Already famous in the biographies of eminent monks, still foremost in the national chess match.
Drawing the bow, let it restrain you for now; sealing Mount Tai will further increase it.
The songs of Ying are inherently hard to match; who else understands the ivory zither?
Phoebe and nan trees reach over distant ravines; swans and geese ripple in the clear sunlight.
The day when the Han founder rose to power, the time when the Shang ancestor enjoyed the kingdom.
Establishing examinations to seek virtue and excellence, making imperial tours to inquire after the aged.
Accommodating teams of four, opening the gates and doors, reaching the clouds and spreading the plumage.
Described in the Qilin Pavilion, meritorious deeds shine on the Ao Stele.
Carefully deliberating in the Cloud Terrace discussions, praising in the songs of Mount Song.
Lofty and majestic, fit for gazing up to; how could one again sigh at the high steps?

src:
微風和暖日鮮明，草色迷人向渭城。
越客捲簾閑不語，楚娥攀樹獨含情。
紅垂菓蔕櫻珠重，黃點花鬢粉蝶輕。
（「鬢」，嚴疑「鬚」之誤。
）自是青樓無近信，莫將心事問卿卿。
tgt:
A gentle breeze and warm sun shine bright, the grass's hue charms the way to Weicheng.
The traveler from Yue rolls up the curtain, silent and at ease; the Chu maiden climbs the tree, her feelings kept alone.
Red hangs from fruit stems, cherries like heavy pearls; yellow dots the flowered temples, powder-like butterflies light.
("Temples" — Yan suspects it is an error for "whiskers.")
Since the blue tower has no recent news, do not ask her, dear, about the matters of your heart.

src:
雲卷雲舒好靜觀，謂宜隠者似無端。
誰知天上爲霖用，竟作人間出岫看。
萬里功名當進步，諸昆時節合彈冠。
只因自得無心趣，三度歸來現宰官。
tgt:
Clouds roll and unfurl, a fine quiet sight to behold,
Fit for a hermit, it seems, yet without reason told.
Who knows that in the sky they serve as rain's design,
Yet in the mortal world they're seen as peaks that shine.
For fame across ten thousand miles, one should advance,
When brothers' time arrives, they ought to dust their hats and dance.
Only because one finds joy in a heart free of intent,
Three times returning, one appears as a magistrate.

src:
雄心脫略戰文場，端把煙蓑換龍章。
葵藿奉君知貴味，肯懷歸去見嚴光。
tgt:
My bold spirit scorns the literary battlefield's strife,
I'd trade my misty rain-cape for the dragon seal of life.
Sunflowers serve the sun, knowing the noble taste,
Would I long to return and see Yan Guang in haste?

src:
烏府參風憲，鯫生負德音。
投閒雖白首，體國尚丹心。
天上浮雲散，江邊秋色深。
第知歌擊壤，寧復賦愁霖。
tgt:
The censorate's wind and discipline, a humble scholar bears the virtuous sound.
Though idle and white-haired, my heart still loyal to the state.
Floating clouds scatter in the sky, autumn colors deepen by the river.
I only know to sing and strike the soil, how could I again compose a song of sorrowful rain.

src:
西來十萬里，北渡一莖蘆。
剛道來傳法，還曾傳得無。
tgt:
From the west he came a hundred thousand li, crossing north on a single reed.
Just saying he came to transmit the Dharma—did he ever transmit anything at all?

src:
池上笙歌寂不聞，樓中愁殺碧虛雲。
玉壺凝盡重重淚，寄與風流舊使君。
tgt:
On the pond, songs and flute music fade, no sound is heard;
In the tower, grief kills the blue empty clouds.
The jade pot has frozen all its layers of tears,
To send to the old romantic governor.

src:
鶑谷聲喧雨乍晴，邦人引領望屏星。
陽和一氣元無際，小爲尋花到野亭。
tgt:
The oriole valley's noisy after rain clears, the townsfolk crane their necks to watch the screen stars.
The harmonious spring air knows no bounds, I stroll to the wild pavilion to look for flowers.

src:
林間幽鳥啄枯槎，落盡寒潮一澗沙。
獨木橋西遊子宿，酒旗斜日兩三家。
tgt:
In the woods a hidden bird pecks at a withered branch, the cold tide has fallen, leaving a ravine of sand.
West of the single-plank bridge, a traveler lodges for the night, a wine flag slants in the setting sun, two or three houses.

src:
六朝遺跡此空存，城壓滄波到海門。
萬里江山来醉眼，九秋天地入吟魂。
于今玉樹悲歌起，當日黄旗王氣昏。
人事不同風物在，悵然猶得對芳樽。

吾友多稱君，思見寒附火。
氣溫玉開籍，才敏鏃加笴。
嘗於師魯書，言詞屢及我。
乖疎久益新，慕合迎已可。
奈何縻組綬，無路動車輠。
近乃得百篇，能詩今信果。
清寒水石春，怪險蛟螭鎖。
遠念煙鴻去，呈妍露葩娜。
古人雖已矣，風流未應墮。
東來勿後期，山桃綴紅顆。
tgt:
My friends often speak of you, longing to see you, cold clinging to fire.
The air warm, jade opens the records, talent keen as an arrow fitted to its shaft.
Once in a letter to Shilu, your words repeatedly mentioned me.
Long estranged, our bond grows ever new; admiring union, welcoming it is already possible.
How then am I bound by official ribbons, with no road to stir the carriage wheels?
Recently I obtained a hundred poems; that you can write poetry now is truly verified.
Clear and cold, water and stone in spring; strange and perilous, dragons and serpents locked.
Afar I think of the misty swan departing, displaying beauty like dew on graceful blossoms.
The ancients, though they are gone, their elegance should not yet fall.
Coming east, do not delay beyond the time; mountain peaches will be studded with red kernels.

src:
欲唱玄雲曲，知音復誰是。
採掇情未來，臨池畫春水。
tgt:
I wish to sing the song of dark clouds, but who is there to understand?
I gather feelings that have yet to come, and by the pool I paint spring water.

src:
渺渺連江雨，微微到面風。
主人留一餉，佳士得相逢。
會面嗟何晚，論詩許有功。
君家好兄弟，更覺此心同。
tgt:
Vast and misty, rain spans the river wide, gently brushing the face, a soft wind sighs.
The host lingers for a while, as kindred spirits meet with grace.
How late we meet, I sigh and say, discussing poems, we find merit in our way.
In your family, good brothers true, I feel our hearts are more alike in view.

src:
僧居岑寂異官居，索句搜腸撚斷鬚。
那更雨中思底事，夢魂歸到種山隅。

朱顔發過如春醅，胸中梨棗初未栽。
丹砂未易掃白髮，赤松却欲參黄梅。
寒溪本自遠公社，白蓮翠竹依崔嵬。
當時石泉照金瑞，神光夜發如五臺。
飲泉鑑面得真意，坐視萬物皆浮埃。
欲收暮景返田里，遠泝江水窮離堆。
還朝豈獨羞老病，自歎才盡傾空罍。
諸公渠渠若夏屋，吞吐風月清隅隈。
我如廢井久不食，古甃缺落生陰苔。
數詩往復相感發，汲新除舊寒光開。
遥知二月春江闊，雪浪倒卷雲峰摧。
石中無聲水亦靜，云何解轉空山雷。
欲就諸公評此語，要識憂喜何從來。
願求南宗一勺水，往與屈賈湔餘哀。
tgt:
My rosy face once glowed like spring wine sweet,
Within my breast no pears or dates had root.
Cinnabar cannot turn white hair to dark;
I'd seek the pine and join the yellow plum.
The cold stream flows far from the old commune,
White lotus and green bamboo lean on cliffs.
Then stone spring mirrored golden rays of grace,
At night divine light shone like Wutai's peak.
Drinking and gazing, I found the true sense,
Seeing all things as floating dust and dirt.
I wish to end my days back in my fields,
Trace the river far to Liduì's height.
Returning to court, ashamed of old age,
I sigh my talent's spent, my cup is dry.
You lords are grand as summer's towering halls,
Breathing in wind and moon from every nook.
I am a ruined well long undrunk from,
My ancient bricks fall, dark moss grows within.
Your poems back and forth stir up my soul,
Draw fresh, cast off the old, cold light breaks through.
I know afar February's river's broad,
Snowy waves roll back, cloud peaks crumble down.
The stone is soundless, water still and calm,
How does it turn to thunder in empty hills?
I wish to ask you lords to judge these words,
To know from whence come sorrow and delight.
I seek one ladle from the Southern School,
To wash away the grief of Qu and Jia.

src:
映阶芳草净无尘。
新晴隔柳阴。
绿丝步障碧茸茵。
遮藏欲尽春。
寒未了，酒须深。
残花无处寻。
年来陪尽惜春心。
闲愁渐不禁。
tgt:
The fragrant grass by the steps is clean and dust-free.
After the rain, willow shadows veil the scene.
Green silken screens, a jade-green velvet lawn.
Hiding away, spring is nearly gone.
Cold lingers still, so wine must flow deep.
Fallen petals nowhere to seek.
Year after year, I've spent my heart grieving for spring.
Idle sorrow grows beyond bearing.

src:
茶選修仁方破碾，簦分吳洞忽當筵。
君謨遠矣知難作，試取一瓢江水煎。
tgt:
Tea selected and cultivated with benevolence, then broken and ground,
Umbrella shared from Wu's cave, suddenly meeting the banquet.
Junmo is far away, knowing it's hard to compose,
Try taking a ladle of river water to brew.

src:
烟拖野色入書窗，一畝平田隔草塘。
暮雨初收新水滿，藕花香雜稻花香。
tgt:
Smoke trails wild hues into my study window, a level acre of field beyond the grassy pond.
The evening rain has just cleared, fresh water brims full, lotus fragrance mingles with the scent of rice blossoms.

src:
应是南枝向暖。
那更青春未晚。
竹外见红腮，芳意与香撩乱。
肠断。
肠断。
无奈东风独占。
tgt:
Surely the southern branch turns toward warmth.
All the more, youth is not yet late.
Beyond the bamboo, a rosy cheek appears, fragrant feeling and scent in a tangled stir.
Heartbreak.
Heartbreak.
There is no way; the east wind keeps it all to itself.

src:
種樹莫種垂楊枝，結交莫結輕薄兒。
楊枝不耐秋風吹，薄交易結還易離。
君不見昨日書來兩相憶，今日相逢不相識。
不如楊柳猶可久，一度春風一回首。
tgt:
Plant trees, don't plant the drooping willow boughs; make friends, don't make with frivolous hearts vows.
The willow branch cannot withstand the autumn wind's blows; a frivolous bond is easily made and easily goes.
Do you not see, yesterday's letters spoke of mutual longing deep, today we meet as strangers, no recognition to keep.
Better the willow, which at least endures a long while, each spring breeze brings a turn of the head, a nostalgic smile.

src:
幽人本無肉食願，岸草溪毛躬自薦。
並隄有芹秀晚春，采掇歸來待朝膳。
tgt:
A recluse has no wish for meat to eat,
He offers cress and river grass, his fare so sweet.
Along the bank, in late spring, celery grows fine,
He gathers it and brings it home for morning meal's design.

src:
虬鬚天人世不有，兩河股裂羣兇手。
健兒誰復知大家，養子朝朝飲牛酒。
廟堂坐論贊皇公，三鎮便同牛馬走。
濯手爲雨噫爲風，斡旋六合臂運肘。
奇章器僅等罍樽，公人中龍彼犬豚。
數百年來號牛李，氣塞不堪今重論。
感時念古寸心切，更覺會昌勳業尊。
未應精爽焄蒿盡，試哦楚些招斷魂。
tgt:
A bearded celestial being, unmatched in the world, with two rivers split by a host of fierce hands.
Who among the stalwart knows the great house, while adopted sons drink cattle wine morning after morning.
In the court, they sit and discuss praising the imperial duke, and the three garrisons then run like cattle and horses.
Washing hands makes rain, breathing out makes wind, turning the six directions with arms and elbows.
The strange chapter's vessel is merely equal to a lei and zun, the duke is a dragon among men, those are dogs and pigs.
For hundreds of years, they have been called Niu and Li, their spirit blocked, unbearable to discuss again today.
Moved by the times, thinking of antiquity, my heart is urgent, and I feel even more the honor of Huichang's achievements.
Their essence should not be entirely gone with the rank grass, try chanting Chu songs to summon the broken soul.

src:
好爵縻人見不休，更饒君盡許封侯。
山林朝市心殊相，莫誤平人枉白頭。
tgt:
The fine rank tempts men endlessly in view, though you be granted a marquisate all through.
In mountain woods or court and mart, hearts differ in their ways; don't mislead common folk to waste their hoary days.

src:
双桨来时，有人似、旧曲桃根桃叶。
歌扇轻约飞花，蛾眉正奇绝。
春渐远、汀洲自绿，更添了、几声啼鴂。
十里扬州，三生杜牧，前事休说。
又还是、宫烛分烟，奈愁里、匆匆换时节。
都把一襟芳思，与空阶榆荚。
千万缕、藏鸦细柳，为玉尊、起舞回雪。
想见西出阳关，故人初别。
tgt:
When the twin oars came, someone seemed like the old song's peach root and peach leaves.
The singing fan gently catches flying blossoms, moth-like eyebrows are truly exquisite.
Spring gradually fades, the sandbar turns green on its own, and adds a few more cries of the cuckoo.
Ten miles of Yangzhou, three lifetimes of Du Mu, let the past be unspoken.
Again it is the time when palace candles share the smoke, but in sorrow, the season changes in haste.
All the fragrant thoughts of a heart are given to the empty steps and elm pods.
Thousands of strands, fine willows hiding crows, dance back the snow for the jade cup.
I can imagine seeing off west of Yangguan, when old friends first part.

src:
讖言雨作風當正，得雨喜如遭旱時。
枕藉無嗔雜簑笠，跧藏不異庇茅茨。
近看楊柳大垂手，遠對雲山圖入眉。
日暮橫流難共濟，明當安穩遂東之。
tgt:
The prophetic rain comes with the wind, just as it should, and when rain arrives, joy is like encountering drought.
Pillowed and nestled without anger, mixed with straw cloaks and hats, crouching hidden is no different from sheltering under a thatched roof.
Up close, the willows hang down like great lowered hands; from afar, facing clouded mountains, they enter the brows like a painting.
At dusk, the sweeping flood makes it hard to cross together; tomorrow, surely, we shall safely go east.

src:
遥聞連理松，託根黄麻城。
枝枝相鉤带，葉葉同死生。
雖云金石姿，未免兒女情。
想應風月夕，滿庭合歡聲。
tgt:
I hear of the twin pines afar, their roots in Huangma Town.
Branch with branch entwines, leaf with leaf shares death and life.
Though praised for metal-and-stone bearing, they cannot escape tender love.
I imagine on moonlit, breezy nights, the whole courtyard rings with joy.

src:
展轉匡牀乍起來，縹缸湘帙亦慵開。
三年一尉湖東住，誰識神仙本姓梅。
tgt:
Tossing on the bed, I rise as soon as I wake;
I will not open bookcase or book for its sake.
For three years east of the lake I lived as a clerk,
Who knows the immortal's surname is Apricot M?

src:
已矣東門路，空悲未盡情。
交親踰四紀，憂患共平生。
此去音容隔，徒多涕淚橫。
蜀山千萬疊，何處是佳城。
tgt:
The eastern gate road is now behind us, vainly grieving emotions not yet spent.
Friends and kin for over four decades, sharing life's sorrows and hardships together.
From now on, voice and face are separated, only tears flow in vain.
Shu's mountains rise in countless folds—where is the fine tomb?

src:
蕩滌真成快，氛霾不敢陰。
萬花恩澤了，二麥寵光深。
地勢瞻仙掌，河源識帝心。
馬頭迎霽色，詩句日邊尋。
tgt:
Washed clean, truly a joy, the haze dares not darken.
Ten thousand flowers have received grace, the two wheats deeply favored by light.
The terrain gazes toward the immortal's palm, the river's source reveals the emperor's heart.
Before the horse's head welcomes the clearing sky, poetic lines are sought by the sun's edge.

src:
姊妹無多兄弟少，舉家鍾愛年最小。
有時繞樹山鵲飛，貪看不待畫眉了。
tgt:
Few sisters and brothers have I, the youngest, cherished by all the family.
Sometimes I chase the magpies flying around the trees, too absorbed to finish painting my eyebrows.

src:
炎正中微，泰極而否。
邊陲雲擾，中原糜沸。
靖康之元，逼我京師。
金湯弛備，兵纏紫微。
天方佑宋，帝在濟陽。
貔貅十萬，左右陳行。
旌旗蔽野，戈鋋彗雲。
八神警蹕，七萃駿奔。
移師商丘，億兆樂推。
謳歌獄訟，竭蹶咸歸。
爰登寶位，爰紹丕基。
兢兢業業，一日萬機。
既巡淮甸，乃涖浙江。
遣使聘問，原隰相望。
兩宮未復，夙夜靡遑。
經之營之，十有餘年。
戊午之秋，使車來旋。
謂彼鄰國，遠達溫言。
欲講盟好，厥志已堅。
使在淮浦，衆言盈庭。
如蜩如螗，如沸如羹。
更唱迭和，萬口狺狺。
帝若不聞，默與神謀。
聖志先定，惟相是諏。
軺車戾止，和好是求。
復我河南，舊縣與州。
疆界方交，左賢被罪。
謀臣既殲，信誓中悔。
古賢繼之，矜其勇鷙。
氛塵冥冥，侵我淮泗。
帝赫斯怒，張我皇威。
乃敕六將，建爾鼓旗。
追奔逐北，于淮之湄。
師入陳許，亦反濉渙。
兩都震懼，人心冰泮。
元戎駃馬，往告于金。
羣情愕眙，罔敢來侵。
皇天悔禍，殊鄰革心。
按兵于境，舊盟是尋。
錫以金帛，稛載方舟。
皇華絡繹，典禮具修。
載書孔明，戎車遄邁。
質于鬼神，萬世永賴。
龍楯來歸，兆庶雨泣。
聖心孺慕，哀恫罔極。
百神畢會，纘禹之迹。
永祐後昆，山川葉吉。
長樂就養，褘衣褕翟。
萬壽稱觴，怡心順色。
晨羞既進，夕膳載加。
天子之孝，修于邦家。
歸馬散牛，句戈束矢。
大將釋師，軍政咸理。
淮濱之民，夜眠晏起。
秉爾耒耜，或耘或宣，惟仲山甫。
愛莫助之，民鮮克舉。
我宋之隆，君臣會通。
咸有一德，協于尹躬。
中興之功，薰灼夷夏。
臣作是詩，以繼周雅。
tgt:
When the sun reached its zenith, it began to wane.
The borderlands were in turmoil, the Central Plains in chaos.
In the first year of Jingkang, the enemy pressed upon our capital.
Our defenses were relaxed, and war engulfed the imperial palace.
Heaven still favored Song, and the emperor was in Jiyang.
With a hundred thousand fierce warriors, arrayed on left and right.
Banners covered the fields, spears and halberds swept the clouds.
The eight spirits cleared the way, the seven elite troops galloped forth.
The army moved to Shangqiu, where millions joyfully acclaimed him.
Songs and legal disputes, all hastened to submit.
Thus he ascended the throne, thus he continued the great foundation.
Diligent and cautious, he handled ten thousand affairs a day.
After touring the Huai region, he then arrived in Zhejiang.
He sent envoys to inquire, their carriages visible across the plains.
The two palaces were not yet restored, day and night he had no rest.
He planned and worked at it for over ten years.
In the autumn of the Wuwu year, the envoy's carriage returned.
He said that the neighboring state had sent distant warm words.
They wished to discuss a treaty of friendship, their resolve already firm.
The envoy was at the Huai River, and the court was full of voices.
Like cicadas, like locusts, like boiling, like soup.
They sang and echoed each other, ten thousand mouths snarling.
The emperor seemed not to hear, silently plotting with the spirits.
His sage will was set beforehand, only consulting his ministers.
The envoy's carriage arrived, seeking peace and friendship.
Restoring to us Henan, the old counties and prefectures.
Just as the borders were being exchanged, the Left Virtuous One was condemned.
The strategist was executed, and the sworn oath was broken midway.
The ancient worthies succeeded him, boasting of their bravery and ferocity.
The dust and smoke darkened, invading our Huai and Si regions.
The emperor was greatly enraged, displaying our imperial might.
He then commanded six generals to raise their drums and banners.
They pursued and chased the fleeing north, on the banks of the Huai.
The army entered Chen and Xu, and also returned to Sui and Huan.
