The two capitals were shaken with fear, people's hearts melted like ice.
The commander's swift horses went to inform the Jin.
The crowd was stunned and stared, not daring to invade.
Heaven regretted the calamity, and the distant neighbor changed its heart.
They halted their troops at the border, seeking the old alliance.
They bestowed gold and silk, loaded onto boats.
Imperial envoys came in continuous stream, and the ceremonies were fully observed.
The covenant was very clear, and the war chariots swiftly advanced.
They pledged before the gods and spirits, relying on them for ten thousand generations.
The dragon shields returned, and the millions wept like rain.
The sage's heart was full of filial longing, grief without end.
All the hundred spirits assembled, continuing Yu's footsteps.
Forever blessing descendants, mountains and rivers in auspicious harmony.
Changluo was supported, with ceremonial robes and pheasant garments.
Toasting to ten thousand years of longevity, with joyful heart and compliant countenance.
Morning delicacies were presented, evening meals were added.
The son of heaven's filial piety was cultivated in the state and family.
Horses were returned and oxen released, spears and arrows were bound.
The great generals released their troops, and military governance was all in order.
The people of the Huai banks slept at night and rose late.
Holding your plows and hoes, some weeding, some cultivating, like Zhongshan Fu.
Love cannot help it, but few people can raise it.
The prosperity of our Song, ruler and ministers in harmony.
All having one virtue, cooperating with the minister's person.
The achievement of restoration, shining upon the Yi and Xia.
Your servant composes this poem, to continue the Zhou ya.

src:
天上瑶池爲別館，海閒金闕是離宮。
徐行按盡烟波國，高步却來雲漢中。
tgt:
The jade pool in heaven serves as a separate lodge; the golden palace by the sea is a detached abode.
Slowly walking, I have traversed the misty and wave-covered realm; with lofty steps, I now come into the Milky Way.

src:
鳳凰池上亦何榮，道義曾知有利名。
達則春風天下共，窮時曉雨隴頭耕。
tgt:
What glory is there atop the Phoenix Pool?
From righteousness, one learns the worth of fame and gain.
When successful, spring breeze shared by all under heaven;
When poor, tilling the ridge in morning rain.

src:
天運無情歲事新，大寶虛位孤王春。
晝出銜恤夜夢哭，皇皇五載臣無君。
南望二王未駐蹕，北憶三宮猶蒙塵。
祅祲蝕日地軸折，冤氣上騰霾蒼旻。
百姓茹苦痛徹髓，大事未定焦如焚。
我寧久處遯悶中，遽忍終死爲逆民。
大哉父母之遺體，與生俱生仁義身。
天鍊精金鑄我心，上籀忠孝兩字文。
痛憶我君我父母，眼中不識天下人。
不變不變不不變，萬挫以死無二心。
醉喝海嶽尚翻動，不信不滅犬羊群。
或謂逝水不可復，叱我癡忠空愁顰。
焉知漢絕十八載，光武乃興舂陵兵。
即此一語斷世事，仰面再拜淚如傾。
tgt:
Heaven's fate is ruthless, the seasons turn anew; the great throne stands empty, I grieve alone for spring.
By day I bear my sorrow, by night I dream and weep; for five long years in fear, no lord to serve as king.
I gaze south to two princes, not yet on their thrones; I think north to three palaces, still shrouded in dust.
An evil omen blots the sun, the earth's axis breaks; wronged spirits rise and choke the azure sky with gloom.
The common folk endure their pain to the very marrow; great matters still unsettled, my heart burns like fire.
How could I long remain in this secluded gloom, and bear at last to die a traitor to my kind?
How great the body our parents gave us at birth— a self of righteousness and benevolence born with life.
Heaven forged my heart from refined and purest gold, and on it inscribed the two words: loyalty and filial piety.
In bitter memory of my lord and my parents, my eyes no longer know the people of the world.
Unchanging, unchanging, I will not change; through ten thousand blows, in death, no second heart.
Drunk, I shout—seas and mountains still overturn; I do not believe the dog-and-sheep horde will not be destroyed.
Some say the water that has passed cannot return, and scold my foolish loyalty, my vain and fretful frown.
How do they know that after Han was cut off eighteen years, Guangwu arose with troops from Chongling?
By this one word I settle all the world's affairs; I lift my face, bow twice, and tears pour down like rain.

src:
晚日登西原，勁風飄我衣。
蕭蕭班馬鳴，野曠行人稀。
撫轡無與語，目送新鴻飛。
俗塵嘆久艱，故山多蕨薇。
tgt:
At dusk I climb the western plain,
The strong wind blows my gown.
I hear the neighing of my horse;
The wilderness is bare, wayfarers few.
I stroke the reins, having no one to talk to,
And watch the new wild geese fly.
I sigh at the long hardship of worldly dust;
My native hills have many ferns and violets.

src:
夏日山居好，凉風樹下生。
三茶還可瀹，二韮尚堪烹。
永日閑言語，平生實講明。
半空飛赤電，燕坐不須驚。
tgt:
In summer, living in the mountains is fine; beneath the trees, a cool breeze arises.
Three cups of tea can still be brewed; two chives are still enough to cook.
All day long, idle talk; throughout life, truly explaining and clarifying.
In midair, red lightning flashes; sitting at ease, there is no need to be startled.

src:
莽莽云平，都不辨、近山远水。
尽徘徊、尚留波面，未归湾尾。
浪猛深深鸥抱稳，波寒缩缩鱼沈底。
恐狂风、颠雨岸多摧，舟难舣。
船篷重，拖不起。
蓑衣湿，森如洗。
想杖头未足，杯中无计。
渔网吹翻无把捉，钓竿冻断成抛弃。
到高歌、风静月明时，谁如你。
tgt:
Vast clouds stretch level, none can tell near hills from distant streams.
Still lingering, they remain on the wave's face, not yet back to the bay's end.
Waves fierce, gulls hold steady deep; water cold, fish shrink and sink to the bottom.
Afraid of wild winds, toppling rains that break the shores, the boat cannot dock.
The boat's canopy is heavy, cannot be dragged up.
The straw raincoat is soaked, drenched as if washed.
Thinking the staff's tip is not enough, in the cup there is no plan.
The fishing net blown over, no grip to hold; the fishing rod frozen and broken, cast away.
Only when singing loud, wind still and moon bright, who is like you?

src:
平湖日炙沸如煮，庭樹色乾鳥渴死。
何人萬里驅征軍，紅塵漲天方入市。
tgt:
The sun-scorched calm lake boils as if in a pot; courtyard trees dry and pale, birds die of thirst.
Who drives a expeditionary army thousands of miles? Red dust rises to the sky just as they enter the market.

src:
漏盡夜沉沉，山房風露深。
無雲生嶺上，有月落波心。

一片如屏紫翠間，風吹日炙蘚花斑。
莫言箇裏無文字，爲待高人著眼看。
（見《淳熙三山志》卷三四、《閩都記》卷二十二。
）。
tgt:
Amid a screen-like stretch of purple and green, wind-blown and sun-scorched, moss flowers are mottled.
Do not say there are no words within; they await a person of high worth to fix their eyes and see.
(Seen in "Chunxi Sanshan Zhi," volume 34, and "Mindu Ji," volume 22.)

src:
堯俗雖勤儉，并兒可嘆嗟。
井牽長頸盎，山駕破轅車。
八月霜如霰，三春雹似瓜。
頭蓬非願女，膏沐欠油麻。
tgt:
Though the folk of Yao are diligent and thrifty, the people of Bing are pitiable.
They draw water from wells with long-necked jars, and on hills drive carts with broken shafts.
In the eighth month, frost falls like sleet; in spring, hail comes like melons.
With unkempt hair, no woman wishes to be, lacking oil and sesame for washing and dressing.

src:
舊恨新愁海樣深，關河魚鴈各飛沈。
芭蕉也似知人意，日日窗前吐寸心。
tgt:
Old griefs and new sorrows are as deep as the sea; across rivers and passes, fish and geese each fly or sink.
The banana tree seems to understand human feelings too, day after day before the window it pours out its heart.

src:
鱠縷絲絲雪色魚，碧筩香細引村沽。
江天此樂誰無分，不問官家乞鑑湖。
tgt:
Fine slivers of fish, snow-white, line by line,
From green bamboo cups, faint fragrance sips village wine.
Who in this river-and-sky joy has no share?
I ask no official for Mirror Lake's care.

src:
要及新香碾一盃，不應傳寶到雲來。
碎身粉骨方餘味，莫厭聲喧萬壑雷。
tgt:
Grind new incense to fill a cup with care,
It should not pass its fragrance to the clouds there.
Only when crushed to dust does its flavor stay,
Do not resent the thunderous roar that fills the vales away.

src:
溳川水竹十家餘，漁艇蓬門對岸居。
大勝塵中走鞍馬，與他軍府判文書。
tgt:
By the riverside of Yun Chuan, ten homes remain,
Fishing boats and thatched doors face each other across the shore.
Far better than galloping through the dust on horseback,
To judge documents in a military office.

src:
競爽吾宗屬俊翹，凌雲辭氣剩飄飄。
十年締思輕傖賦，一骨評風壓楚謠。
縱玩書窗迷野馬，長吟秋社續寒蜩。
夫君自有何郎恨，枉使東陽臂肉銷。
tgt:
Outshining our clan, you stand tall and proud,
Your soaring words and spirit drift like clouds.
A decade's thoughts dismiss the shallow rhymes,
One frame of style outweighs Chu's ancient songs.
Lost in books by the window, wild horses roam,
Long chanting autumn verses, cold cicadas drone.
My lord, you bear the grief of He Lang's fate,
In vain Dongyang's arm and flesh waste away.

src:
公在春官我已归。
公来东蜀我居西。
及公自遂移潼日，正我由潼使遂时。
如有碍，巧相违。
人生禁得几分飞。
只祈彼此身长健，同处何曾有别离。
tgt:
You served in the Ministry of Rites when I had already returned.
You came to Eastern Shu as I dwelt in the west.
When you moved from Suining to Tongchuan,
It was exactly when I was sent from Tongchuan to Suining.
As if there were obstacles, we just kept missing each other.
How much of life's flight can one endure?
I only pray that we both stay in good health forever—
When together, how could there ever be parting?

src:
蓪草頭花椰葉裙，蒲葵樹下舞蠻雲。
引領望江遙滴酒，白蘋風起水生文。
tgt:
A flower of rice-paper plant and a skirt of coconut leaves,
Under the palm trees dancing in the southern clouds.
Gazing toward the river, I pour wine from afar,
As white grass bends in the wind, ripples form on the water.

src:
顛倒八八卦，流轉三百六。
前民此何神，占險空屢瀆。
以病既當止，以年自當休。
春泥不補裂，莫謾任虛舟。
tgt:
The eight trigrams are all reversed, cycling through three hundred and sixty.
Why did the ancients deem this divine, divining dangers in vain again and again?
When illness comes, one should stop; when age arrives, one should rest.
Spring mud cannot mend the cracks; do not idly let the empty boat drift.

src:
辇路融晴，宫云逗晓青旗报。
梅边香沁彩鞭寒，初信花风到。
笑语谁家帘幕，镂冰丝、红粉绿闹。
髻横玉燕，鬓颤琼幡，不能知掉。
看见春来，麴尘微涨催兰棹。
娇横拂略上柔条，等得莺眠觉。
引出千花万草。
喜搀先、椒盘竹爆。
问谁天上，瑶帖初供，玉堂归儤。
tgt:
The imperial path melts in clear sunshine, palace clouds tease the dawn as blue banners announce.
By the plum blossoms, fragrance seeps into the cold colorful whip, first tidings of flower wind arrive.
Laughter and chatter from whose curtains, carved ice threads, red and green clamor.
Hairpins with jade swallows, temples trembling with jade banners, cannot be known to fall.
Seeing spring arrive, faint dust slightly rises urging orchid oars.
Delicately brushing across the soft branches, waiting for the oriole to wake from sleep.
Drawing out thousands of flowers and grasses.
Joyfully mixing first, pepper plates and bamboo firecrackers.
Ask who in heaven, jade tablets first offered, returning to the jade hall for duty.

src:
衆人哺啜喜君醒，渭水由來不雜涇。
遮莫雪霜撩亂下，松枝竹葉自青青。
tgt:
While all others feast and drink, I rejoice that you are sober;
The Wei River's waters have never mixed with the Jing.
Though snow and frost may fall in wild confusion,
The pine branches and bamboo leaves stay green.

src:
舊歷關中憶廢興，僭奢須戒儉須憑。
火光只是燒秦冢，賊眼何曾視灞陵。
鐘鼓煎催人自急，侯王更換恨難勝。
不如坐釣清溪月，心共寒潭一片澄。
tgt:
In the old capital, memories of rise and fall remain, extravagance must be warned against, frugality must be upheld.
The flames only burned the Qin tombs, how could thieving eyes ever look upon Ba Ling.
Bells and drums urge people to hurry on their own, lords and kings replace one another, resentment hard to bear.
Better to sit and fish by the clear stream's moon, heart together with the cold pool, one一片 clarity.

src:
火雲爍石畏出戶，正似雪深堅卧時。
吾甘饑凍死即死，觸熱生慚褦襶兒。
tgt:
The fiery clouds scorch stones—I fear to leave my door,
Just like when snow lies deep and I stay firm in bed.
I'd rather starve and freeze, and die if die I must,
Than face the heat and feel ashamed before the sun.

src:
早禾割盡晚禾青，地下知章果有靈。
豈憶鑑湖曾敕賜，連山雲霧雨冥冥。
tgt:
The early rice is harvested, the late rice still green,
Beneath the earth, does Zhang truly have a spirit?
How could he recall the Mirror Lake once granted by imperial decree?
Continuous mountains, clouds and mist, rain dark and deep.

src:
嗷嗷哀鳴肅肅羽，魂清意爽愛湘楚。
西風作惡陣脚散，斜行千點下煙浦。
飛力已困日且晡，便欲就宿依寒蘆。
大者居中圍以奴，丁寧緩急相驚呼。
嗟此何景兮平沙鴈落，丹青欲盡未易著。
tgt:
Loud and mournful cries, solemn and solemn feathers, the soul is clear and the mind is refreshed, loving the Xiang and Chu regions.
The west wind stirs up trouble, scattering the formation's foothold, slanting lines of a thousand points descend to the misty shores.
The flying strength is already exhausted, and the day is approaching dusk, so they wish to roost and rely on the cold reeds.
The larger ones stay in the center, surrounded by their subordinates, giving careful instructions, calling out in alarm at slow or urgent moments.
Alas, what scene is this? Wild geese landing on the flat sand, painting desires to capture it all, yet it is not easy to depict.

src:
南岳夫人綠酒春，近來未及玉膏醇。
穆生不許聊須强，他日瀛洲是故人。

灼灼葉中花，夏萎春又芳。
明明天上月，蟾缺圓復光。
未如君子情，朝違夕已忘。
玉帳枕猶暖，紈扇思何長。
願因西南風，吹上玳瑁牀。
嬌眠錦衾裏，展轉雙鴛鴦。
tgt:
Bright flowers among the leaves, wilt in summer, bloom again in spring.
Brightly shines the moon above, waxing, waning, then full again.
But not so the gentleman's love, gone by dusk, forgotten by morn.
The jade tent pillow still warm, how long the silk fan's longing.
Would that by the southwest wind, I be blown onto his tortoiseshell bed.
Sleeping sweetly in brocade quilts, we turn as a pair of mandarin ducks.

src:
青春過隙不多時，佳會應須日日期。
羨子多情勤秉燭，尋芳問柳每題詩。
洛花名字爭新見，尤物東君翦刻遲。
安得韓湘寫奇句，世間鉛粉謾勞施。
tgt:
Youth slips away in no time, so gatherings should be held day after day.
I envy you, so full of feeling, diligently holding a candle, seeking flowers and asking willows, writing poems each time.
The names of Luoyang flowers compete to appear anew, and the rare beauties are slow to be cut and carved by the Lord of Spring.
How can one get Han Xiang to write wondrous lines? In this world, white lead powder is vainly applied in vain.

src:
門大聯三虎，途窮曳九牛。
一官投紱去，萬事蓋棺休。
寂寂蘭亭月，寥寥蕙帳秋。
羊曇他日淚，慟哭過西州。
tgt:
The gate is grand, allied with three tigers; the road ends, dragging nine oxen.
Once an official, he cast off his sash and left; all matters are sealed with the coffin and done.
Silent, silent, the moon over the Orchid Pavilion; sparse, sparse, the autumn of the iris tent.
Yang Tan's tears on another day; weeping bitterly, he passed by Xizhou.

src:
若今生 乱世如麻
 尔虞我诈
便许你来世锦绣荣华 满城烟花
君可愿白衣饮茶
清风瘦马
再唱一曲六月雨下
当了七年诟病人
不曾进入你心门
风情万种失了神哪
却不敌她一座坟
你是将军我是妓
身披战袍无人替
不负王也不负帝
却赠我一生孤寂
我想打开你心门
你心却有一道痕
她的笑 太销魂
留我独自去沉沦
终于做回我自己
深巷酒肆琴一曲
你说别想离开你 终究是我输不起
 我肮脏 我绝望
*******
你说她在你心上
怎能代替她模样
爱你如毒 毒刺骨
你却拿命 和我赌
*******
一生眷恋化尘土
你是将军我是妓
始终无法把她替
你是将军我是妓
爱恨成痴空回忆
奈何桥 孟婆汤
红尘往事终成伤
我的爱 并不脏
酒醉金迷夜未央
如有来世不做妓
愿意随你一同去
若有来生再相聚
但愿不要把我弃
来生若能长相守
这段深情换你有
别让我 等太久
太阳下山我就走
三生石旁你可在
彼岸花开在等待
若你不负相思债
可愿来生把我爱
这一世
你始终不承认你爱我
你说
我是妓
怎能和她比
你说
她的笑你记挂了一辈子
其实
她的笑我练习了一辈子
tgt:
If in this life the world is in chaos
Full of deceit
Then I promise you glory in the next life, fireworks throughout the city
Would you be willing to drink tea in white robes
A gentle breeze, a lean horse
And sing once more of June rain falling
Having been a sick man for seven years
Never once entering your heart
I lost myself in countless charms
Yet could not rival a single grave of hers
You are a general, I am a courtesan
Clad in battle robes, no one to take your place
You failed neither king nor emperor
Yet gifted me a lifetime of solitude
I want to open your heart
But your heart bears a scar
Her smile, so enchanting
Left me alone to sink
Finally I return to myself
A song on the lute in a deep alley tavern
You say don't think of leaving you, in the end I cannot afford to lose
I am filthy, I am desperate
*******
You say she is in your heart
How could I replace her likeness
Loving you is like poison, poison to the bone
Yet you gamble with your life against me
*******
A lifetime of longing turns to dust
You are a general, I am a courtesan
Never able to take her place
You are a general, I am a courtesan
Love and hate turn to obsession, empty memories
The Bridge of Helplessness, Meng Po's soup
Mortal affairs at last become wounds
My love is not dirty
Drunk on gold and dazzled, the night is not yet over
If there is a next life, I will not be a courtesan
Willing to go with you
If we meet again in another life
I only hope you will not abandon me
If in the next life we can stay together
This deep love I exchange for you
Don't make me wait too long
When the sun sets, I will leave
Are you there by the Three-Life Stone
The other shore flowers bloom in waiting
If you do not betray the debt of longing
Would you be willing to love me in the next life
In this life
You never admitted you loved me
You said
I am a courtesan
How can I compare to her
You said
You remembered her smile for a lifetime
In truth
I practiced her smile for a lifetime

src:
妙喜胸中流出底，重華天子手親書。
大千俱壞此不壞，別板刊行亦聽渠。
tgt:
From the depths of wondrous joy in the heart it flows,
By the hand of the Emperor Chonghua personally inscribed.
Though the vast cosmos may perish, this shall not perish,
If it is carved and published on separate blocks, so be it.

src:
衆星已窮次，青帝方行春。
永感易成戚，離居難重陳。
闔門守初夜，燎火到清晨。
或念無生法，多傷未出塵。
廣庭日將晏，虛室自爲賓。
願以桑榆末，常逢甲子新。
tgt:
The stars have exhausted their courses, the Azure Emperor just begins spring.
Everlasting sorrow easily turns to grief, living apart is hard to recount again.
Closing the gate, guarding the first night, kindling fire until dawn.
Some think of the teaching of no-birth, many are wounded by not yet leaving the dust.
In the broad courtyard the day will soon fade, in the empty room I am my own guest.
I wish that at the end of life's twilight, I may always meet the renewal of the sixty-year cycle.

src:
水因有月方知靜，天爲無雲始覺高。
獨坐孤峯休更問，此時難著一絲毫。
tgt:
The water knows stillness only when it holds the moon;
The sky feels high only when no cloud remains.
Sitting alone on a lonely peak, ask no more—
At this moment, not even a thread can be placed.

src:
顯志實堪誇，雪內放黃花。
寒暑不相礙，獨體草結砂。
tgt:
Its noble resolve is truly praiseworthy, blooming yellow flowers amid the snow.
Cold and heat do not hinder it; alone, its body binds sand with grass.

src:
梅花耐寒白如玉，干涉春風紅更黄。
若爲司花示薄罰，到底不能磨滅香。
tgt:
The plum blossom endures cold, white as jade,
Braving the spring wind, red turns more yellow.
If the flower guardian metes out light punishment,
In the end, its fragrance cannot be erased.

src:
亟報門前寄好音，炯然書札照家林。
興來自說宦情薄，詩到方知秋思深。
臨老讀書因教子，閉門捫蝨爲搜吟。
當今大筆如君少，未用深藏嘆陸沈。
tgt:
Urgent news arrives at my door, a welcome sound,
A luminous letter brightens my home's ground.
Inspired, he speaks of official life's thin cheer,
Only in poetry does autumn's deep thought appear.
Aging, I read to teach my son,
Shut the door, picking lice while searching for a song.
Today, few wield a pen as great as yours,
No need to hide deep and lament being sunk and ignored.

src:
謬佐驅雞任，常思賦鵩人。
未諧林下約，空感病來身。
鏁徑青苔老，鋪階紅葉新。
相思不可見，猶喜得書頻。
tgt:
Miao Zuo drove chickens as he pleased, I often think of the man who wrote of owls.
The vow beneath the trees remains unfulfilled, in vain I grieve this sickly body.
The path is locked, green moss grown old, the steps are spread with fresh red leaves.
I long for you but cannot see you, yet I am glad your letters come so often.

src:
柳带分陰接殿基，笙歌還擁翠華歸。
前宫曉赭匀粧臉，别館春紅曬舞衣。
槐影對籠苔點細，桐花西倚夕陽稀。
夜来夢上檀香閣，猶映珠簾避貴妃。
tgt:
Willow belts part the shade, touching the palace foundation, music and song still escort the jade imperial return.
In the front palace, dawn's red evenly adorns made-up faces, in the separate lodge, spring red dries dancing garments.
Locust shadows face and enclose, moss dots are fine, tung flowers lean west where evening sunlight is sparse.
At night I dream of ascending the sandalwood incense pavilion, still reflecting pearl blinds to avoid the noble consort.

src:
平高就下得其宜，出谷遷喬只舊蹊。
天上好風人不見，共觀百草一頭低。
tgt:
To level heights and lower downs is fitting and right; Leaving the vale, moving to the heights, still on the old path.
The good wind in the sky is unseen by people; Together they watch the hundred grasses bow their heads as one.

src:
仕宦自飄然，君恩豈欲偏。
纔歸劍門道，忽上洞庭船。
墜絮傷春目，舂濤廢夜眠。
岳陽樓上月，清賞浩無邊。
tgt:
An official's life drifts like a leaf, why should the ruler's favor lean to one side?
Just returned to the road of Sword Gate, suddenly I board a boat on Dongting Lake.
Falling willow catkins wound the spring-viewing eyes, pounding waves ruin nighttime sleep.
Above Yueyang Tower, the moon shines, its pure beauty vast and boundless.

src:
往說齊侯寢，此堂申甫餘。
千齡長秀聳，衆木既消除。
杖履每多興，冰霜冞自如。
凉風破蒸暑，真賞復誰須。
tgt:
To persuade the Marquis of Qi to rest, this hall holds Shenfu's legacy.
A thousand years of towering grace, while other trees have faded away.
With staff and shoes, joy often arises, through ice and frost, ever unshaken.
Cool winds break the sweltering heat—true appreciation, who else needs it?

src:
秋波紅蓼水，夕照青蕪岸。
獨信馬蹄行，曲江池四畔。
早涼晴後至，殘暑暝來散。
方喜炎燠銷，復嗟時節換。
我年三十六，冉冉昏復旦。
人壽七十稀，七十新過半。
且當對酒笑，勿起臨風歎。
tgt:
Autumn waves on the red polygonum water, evening sunlight on the green overgrown bank.
Alone, trusting my horse's hooves to go, around the four sides of Qujiang Pool.
Early cool arrives after the clearing, lingering heat disperses as dusk comes.
Just glad the sweltering heat has faded, then sigh again that the season has changed.
I am thirty-six years old, slowly passing from dusk to dawn.
Human life at seventy is rare, and seventy has just passed half.
For now, I should laugh before the wine, and not rise to sigh in the wind.

src:
萬騎南來駐不留，衣冠客此鎮林丘。
寒岩碎裂從中起，亂水喧鳴竟獨流。
故物今惟存寓馬，當年誰爲指眠牛。
墳傍小寺終村俗，畫柱紗籠護冕旒。
tgt:
Ten thousand horsemen came south and stayed not, scholars and officials settled here among the woods and hills.
The cold cliff shattered and split from within, chaotic waters roared and raced alone.
Of old things only the lodging horses remain; who back then pointed out the sleeping ox?
Beside the tomb, a small temple ends in rustic vulgarity, painted pillars and gauze lanterns guard the crown and tassels.

src:
閒客何庸早起忙，高眠懶復問雲祥。
宦情不作葭灰動，吟筆寧爭繡線長。
逆旅四年逢此節，徒行六日可吾鄉。
衝風踏雪須歸去，薺菜肥甜白酒香。
tgt:
An idle man, why bother rising early and busying himself?
I sleep late, too lazy to ask if clouds bring good omens.
Official ambition does not stir like reed-ash in the pipe;
Would my writing brush compete to be longer than embroidery thread?
Four years in a traveler's inn, I meet this festival;
Walking on foot six days, I can reach my home.
Braving wind and treading snow, I must go back,
Where shepherd's purse is plump and sweet, and white wine fragrant.

src:
咄哉滅胡種，面目真可惡。
過橋便拆橋，得路便塞路。
雖欲彊柔和，畢竟觸人怒。
萬事類如此，誰敢相親附。
乞兒囊本空，常誇敵國富。
聞說閻羅王，未免生怕怖。
休更放大言，嫌佛不肯做。
tgt:
How absurd, wiping out the Hu kind, their faces truly detestable.
Cross the bridge, then tear it down; find a path, then block it.
Though one may try to force gentleness, in the end it provokes anger.
All things are like this—who would dare draw close?
A beggar's sack is empty, yet he often boasts of a rival nation's wealth.
Hearing of King Yama, he cannot help but feel dread.
Stop making grand claims—you disdain even the Buddha and refuse to become one.

src:
迟日江山好，老去倦遨游。
好天良夜，自恨无地可销忧。
岂意绮窗朱户，深锁双双玉树，桃扇避风流。
未暇泛沧海，直欲老温柔。
解檀槽，敲玉钏，泛清讴。
画楼十二，梁尘惊坠彩云留。
座上骑鲸仙友，笑我胸中磊磈，取酒为浇愁。
一举千觞尽，来日判扶头。
tgt:
Late sun on hills and streams is fine, but I am old and tired of roaming.
On such a fine day and good night, I regret there's nowhere to dispel my sorrow.
Who would have thought behind the ornate windows and crimson doors, deeply locked away two jade trees, peach fan avoids the romantic breeze.
No time to sail the vast seas, I'd rather grow old in tenderness.
Unfasten the sandalwood pegs, strike the jade bracelets, let clear songs flow.
In the painted tower of twelve, dust on the beams startled to fall, colorful clouds linger.
Among the guests, a whale-riding immortal friend, laughs at the rocky blocks in my chest, takes wine to drown my sorrow.
One raise, a thousand cups drained, tomorrow I'll surely need to prop up my head.

src:
芙蓉濕曉露，秋別南浦中。
鴛鴦卷新贈，遙戀東牀空。
碧水不息浪，清溪易生風。
參差坐成阻，飄颻去無窮。
孤雲目雖斷，明月心相通。
私情詎銷鑠，積芳在春藂。
tgt:
Hibiscus wet with morning dew, we part in autumn at the southern shore.
Mandarin ducks roll up new gifts, longing afar for the empty eastern bed.
Green waters never cease their waves, clear streams easily stir the wind.
Scattered and seated, we become obstructed, drifting away without end.
Though the lone cloud vanishes from sight, the bright moon connects our hearts.
How could private feelings melt away? Accumulated fragrance remains in the spring thicket.

src:
石磴不容步，喬林森迴還。
聞昔有威鳳，養羽留此山。
乘此去翺翔，得意今不還。
餘音落何處，尚在雲泉間。
陳迹雖可尋，飛轍誰能攀。
tgt:
Stone steps allow no foothold, tall trees densely wind around.
I hear once a majestic phoenix nurtured its feathers on this hill.
Riding the wind it soared away, content, and returns no more.
Where did its lingering notes fall? Still within cloud and spring.
Though old traces may be found, who can climb its flying track?

src:
爛柯山下採樵民，盡日觀棋局局新。
黑白兩般都著過，後來一著要高人。
tgt:
Beneath Lan Ke Mountain, a woodcutter lives,
Watching chess games all day, each move fresh and new.
Both black and white pieces he has played through,
But the final move requires a master's view.

src:
景泮冰檐，情回瑶草。
副能守得春来到。
管曾独自索春怜，而今觑著东风笑。
粉凝酥寒，云房睡觉。
胭脂也不添些小。
天真要与此花争，是伊占得春多少。
tgt:
Frozen eaves gleam by the pool, jade grass stirs with feeling.
How could one keep spring here before it slips away?
I once begged spring for pity all alone,
But now I watch the east wind and smile.
Powder congeals, cream grows cold, waking from a cloud-chamber sleep.
Not even a touch more rouge is added.
If innocence would vie with this flower,
How much of spring has she claimed for her own?

src:
河尹政成期，爲汾昔所推。
不榮三入地，還美再臨時。
擁傳雲初合，聞鶯日正遲。
道傍多出餞，別有吏民思。
tgt:
The time when the river's governor achieved success, was once praised for his governance of Fen.
Not glorying in three entries to the land, but again beautifying the time of second arrival.
With a convoy, the clouds just gather, hearing the orioles, the day is still slow.
By the roadside, many come out to give farewell feasts, uniquely there is longing from officials and people.

src:
平蓋山高古木疎，昔人曾此築仙居。
井通八角寒泉湧，觀燬三清劫火餘。
洗墨池邊丹竈冷，繫龍巖畔石潭虛。
吟成獨坐荒苔上，閑看蝸牛學篆書。
（《蜀中名勝記》十二《眉州彭山縣》）。

其秀維何，奕葉有儺。
春種秋實，備時中和。
tgt:
How splendid is its grace, generation after generation there are the Nuo.
Spring planting and autumn harvest, in harmony with the seasons.

src:
霜晴忽念到江干，小蹇羸童路已乾。
骨相豈能當富貴，鬢毛聊喜耐悲歡。
客途冬暖衣裘薄，村市年豐酒盞寬。
殘臘即今無十日，剩求芹蓼助春盤。

巖頭古佛留心印，巖下高人新受持。
佛亦本來無隠現，人於悟處領希夷。
莫嫌夢裏還談夢，且看奇中更有奇。
他日證成羅漢果，相逢不必問伊誰。
tgt:
The ancient Buddha on the cliff left his mind-seal; beneath the cliff, a lofty one newly receives and upholds it.
The Buddha was originally without hidden or manifest appearance; a person, at the point of awakening, grasps the subtle and indistinct.
Do not disdain talking of dreams within a dream; just look at how the wondrous contains still more wonder.
One day, when you attain the fruit of Arhatship, meeting again, there will be no need to ask who you are.

src:
桐廬縣前洲渚平，桐廬江上晚潮生。
莫言獨有山川秀，過日仍聞官長清。
麥隴虛涼當水店，鱸魚鮮美稱蓴羹。
王孫客棹殘春去，相送河橋羨此行。
tgt:
Before Tonglu County, the sandbars lie flat and wide,
On Tonglu River, evening tides begin to rise.
Say not that only hills and streams are fair to see,
For days gone by, the magistrate's repute still rings.
Wheat fields lie cool and empty by the waterside inn,
The perch is fresh and fine, matching water-shield soup.
The noble guest's boat departs as late spring fades away,
Seeing him off at the river bridge, I envy his journey.

src:
寂寂度年光，堅貞玉雪香。
冶容誰氏子，終日傍垂楊。
tgt:
Silently passing the years, steadfast as fragrant jade and snow.
Whose child is that fair-faced one, lingering all day by the weeping willow?

src:
自君之出矣，饑民日北首。
春從二天來，共拜更生手。
未議解倒垂，促膝此何有。
非君面揚榷，誰有筆端口。
tgt:
Since you departed, the hungry people daily face north.
Spring comes from the two heavens, together they bow to the hand that gives rebirth.
Before discussing relief for those hanging upside down, what is there in sitting knee to knee?
Without you to speak and weigh face to face, who has a pen at the mouth?

src:
空青老仙伯，有子愛溪山。
誰信南坡路，依依泉石間。
tgt:
The old immortal of the empty blue, has a son who loves the creeks and mountains.
Who would believe the south slope road, lingering among springs and stones.

src:
春晚傷爲客，月明思見君。
我方慕蘇武，誰復從田文。
龍背夾紅日，雁聲連白雲。
琶琵漢宮曲，馬上不堪聞。
tgt:
Spring evenings wound me as a stranger here,
Beneath the moon I long to see you, dear.
I now admire Su Wu of old renown,
Who follows Tian Wen when the world's cast down?
On dragon's back the red sun rides on high,
Wild geese calls drift across the white cloud sky.
The pipa plays a Han palace refrain,
Unbearable to hear on horseback's plain.

src:
一川晴日破春容，柳絮桃紅赴望中。
莫喜芳辰又來到，少年能耐幾東風。
tgt:
A bright spring day breaks across the river's face,
Willow catkins and peach blossoms come into view.
Do not rejoice that the fragrant season has arrived again,
How many east winds can a young man endure?

src:
幾年困塵鞿，厥狀浸成俗。
比來夢魂清，勝賞得林麓。
群峰綰烟鬟，炯炯皆在目。
寒碧冷相射，秀氣還可掬。
哦詩三伏中，清風起幽谷。
只恐吹我衣，化爲雲錦服。
汗流籍湜輩，上下相追逐。
tgt:
For years I've been trapped in the dust of the world, my appearance gradually becoming common.
Recently my dreaming soul has been clear, and I've found fine scenery in the forested hills.
The clustered peaks wear coiling mist like hair, all shining bright before my eyes.
Cold azure and chill light strike against each other, and the elegant air seems almost graspable.
Chanting poems in the midst of the dog days, a clear breeze rises from the secluded valley.
I only fear it will blow against my clothes and turn them into cloud-brocade robes.
The sweat-soaked crowd of followers, chasing one another up and down.

src:
古洞深沉莫敢窺，森陰草木野雲飛。
白龍何處淹頭角，天下蒼生望汝歸。
tgt:
The ancient cave is deep, none dare to peer inside; dense shade, wild grass and trees, wild clouds fly by.
Where has the white dragon submerged its head and horns? All living beings under heaven await your return.

src:
烏銜霽色朝迎馬，蟾吐澄輝夜照眠。
日月於君已如此，不須星曆問行年。
tgt:
A crow holds dawn in its beak, greeting horses at daybreak;
The moon pours clear radiance, shining on sleep at night.
Sun and moon have already been like this for you—
No need for star almanacs to ask about the passing years.

src:
不見我公久，摇摇動心旌。
敢以一瓣香，爲公罄精誠。
tgt:
Not seeing my lord for so long, my heart sways restless.
I dare offer a petal of incense, to pour out my sincere devotion for you.

src:
蘇州楊柳任君誇，更有錢唐勝館娃。
若解多情尋小小，綠楊深處是蘇家。
tgt:
The willows of Suzhou may be praised by you at will,
But West Lake in Qiantang surpasses the palace still.
If you would seek for the passionate girl so fair,
Deep in the green willows is the Su family there.

src:
天晚日沈沈，歸舟繫柳陰。
江村平見寺，山郭遠聞砧。
樹密猿聲響，波澄鴈影深。
榮華暫時事，誰識子陵心。
tgt:
The day is late, the sun is sinking low,
The returning boat is tied in the willow shade.
The river village is level, a temple comes into view,
From the mountain town afar comes the sound of washing.
The trees are dense, the monkeys' cries resound,
The waves are clear, the geese's shadows are deep.
Glory and splendor are but temporary things,
Who understands the heart of Ziling?

src:
知爾今何處，孤高獨不羣。
論詩唯許我，窮易到無文。
貰酒兒穿雪，尋僧月照雲。
何時再相見，兵寇尚紛紛。
tgt:
Do I know where you are now, aloof and unmatched?
In poetry you praised only me; in the Book of Changes, you reached wordlessness.
To buy wine, your son braved the snow; seeking monks, the moon lit the clouds.
When shall we meet again? Bandits and soldiers still in turmoil.

src:
慇懃圯上一編書，漢四百年歸卷舒。
晚節莫教閑辟穀，皇王事業豈難如。
tgt:
A book on the bridge, offered with earnest grace,
Four hundred years of Han, folded and spread in place.
Let not old age be spent in idle fasting's art,
Are kingly deeds so hard to play a part?

src:
光風細細飄香轉，綠葉陰陰覆檻涼。
雲物鮮明時節麗，水精宮殿侍君王。
tgt:
The gentle breeze carries fragrance as it softly turns,
Green leaves cast cool shade over the balustrade.
Clouds and scenes are bright, the season fair and fine,
In crystal palaces, attending the sovereign.

src:
東風窮巷只埃塵，誰見城南萬朵新。
不問主人聊一飲，爲携佳客送餘春。
比君意氣三年老，貸我疏狂一味真。
醉裏尚能馳馬去，看君倒著接䍦巾。
tgt:
In the east wind's poor lane only dust and dirt remain, who sees ten thousand new blooms south of the city.
Not asking the host, I casually drink a cup, to bring a fine guest and send off the lingering spring.
Compared to you, my spirit has aged three years, but you lend me my unruly wildness, one pure flavor.
Still drunk, I can yet gallop away on horseback, and watch you wear your headcloth askew.

src:
祗愁窮臘雪作惡，不道雪天好行樂。
玻瓈盞底回青春，蒲萄錦外舞玉塵。
陽春一曲小垂手，勸君一杯千萬壽。
今年斛穀才八錢，明年切莫羨今年。
tgt:
I only fear the year-end snow will play havoc, not knowing a snowy day is good for merrymaking.
In the glass cup, youth returns; beyond the grape-patterned brocade, jade dust dances.
A song of Sunny Spring, a small drooping-hand dance; I urge you to take a cup for a thousand years of life.
This year a bushel of grain costs only eight coins; next year, by all means do not envy this year.

src:
五月炎風熾，憂勤紫掖中。
催裁恤刑詔，曉下未央宮。
tgt:
In May the scorching wind blazes hot,
Amid the purple palace, diligent and concerned.
Urging the drafting of a decree to show mercy in punishment,
At dawn it is issued from the Weiyang Palace.

src:
密雪界秋冬，悲歡可得同。
祥如關歲事，時合奏場功。
政要肉骨手，民方霜葉風。
强吟鹽絮句，面不蓋羞紅。
tgt:
Deep snow marks autumn's end and winter's reign, can joy and sorrow be the same?
Auspicious omens close the year's affairs, in season we celebrate the harvest's gains.
The ruler needs hands that mend flesh and bone, the people face the frost-leaf wind alone.
I force a verse of salt and willow down, my face cannot hide the blush of shame.

src:
秋風吹霜入松柏，虚谷聲遙寒刺刺。
月華正高星宿稀，獨鶴不鳴觜插翼。
是時夫子爲我吟，逸調雄才世無敵。
十年學詩自謂豪，一日逢君有慚色。
恍疑醉夢太帝家，寶藏珠樓不知極。
蟠桃結實九重春，金銀琅玕萬林直。
須臾收拾到平淡，雨洗高峰增老碧。
又如摩詰畫思精，一幅霜綃數拳石。
鬼神怪變露形狀，天地英華發胸臆。
我家江南謝朓山，山深流水長潺潺。
獼猴摘果趁不去，白雲常在衣裳間。
斷無車馬送塵土，獨與猿鳥期追攀。
一杯有酌醉復醉，萬慮不到閒中閒。
欲邀君去詠此景，願窺巨筆追揚班。
其餘功業未足數，天馬安得趨塵寰。
tgt:
Autumn wind blows frost into pines and cypresses, empty valleys echo distant and coldly piercing.
The moonlight is high and the stars are few, a lone crane does not call, its beak tucked, wings folded.
At this time the Master chants for me, with untrammeled tone and heroic talent unmatched in the world.
Ten years studying poetry, I called myself bold, but meeting you one day brings shame to my face.
As if in drunken dream in the Great Emperor's home, jeweled towers and treasure houses beyond knowing.
Peaches of immortality ripen through ninefold spring, gold and silver, jade and bamboo, ten thousand groves stand straight.
In a moment all is gathered into plainness, rain washes the high peaks, adding olden blue.
Again like Mojie's painting, precise in thought, one幅 frosty silk with several fist-sized stones.
Ghosts and spirits, monstrous transformations reveal their forms, the essence of heaven and earth issues from the breast.
My home is in Jiangnan, on Xie Tiao's mountain, deep in the hills, flowing water ever murmuring.
Macaques pick fruit, I cannot shoo them away, white clouds ever linger among my clothes.
No carriages or horses bring dust, alone with apes and birds I seek to follow and climb.
One cup, I drink and get drunk, then drunk again, ten thousand cares do not reach me in leisure within leisure.
I want to invite you to go and sing of this scene, wishing to glimpse your giant brush and rival Yang and Ban.
Other achievements are not worth counting, how can a heavenly steed gallop in the dusty world?

src:
楚國中分後，東南世澤長。
發祥曾王父，磨勘成典章。
王父聲益振，主客尚書郎。
考廟緒丕顯，直鯁在巖廊。
歷歷一精白，敬事持人綱。
顧維予小子，念釋茲勿忘。
晴空麗皎日，清秋凜嚴霜。
金石磨不磷，松柏寒逾芳。
旦評猶足信，清議詎虛張。
夢寐滋洗滌，俯仰隨否臧。
所值匪所思，盈虧理有常。
亨途無詭遇，偃蹇嘶驪黄。
誰能餌大藥，百年身平康。
tgt:
After Chu was divided, southeast blessings long endure.
Our forebear prospered, and through review shaped statutes.
Grandfather's fame grew stronger, a host-guest and ministerial lord.
Our ancestral temple's thread shone greatly, upright and blunt in the court.
Clear and spotless one by one, he revered his work and upheld human bonds.
But I, this little child, think of release and never forget it.
Bright sun adorns the clear sky, stern frost chills the clear autumn.
Metal and stone are ground but not worn thin; pines and cypress grow more fragrant in cold.
Morning judgments are still trustworthy; pure discussions are not vainly spread.
Dreams and sleep increasingly wash me clean; bowing and lifting follow praise or blame.
What is met is not what is thought; waxing and waning have constant principle.
On the smooth road there are no crooked encounters; fallen and halting, the black and yellow horses neigh.
Who can take the great elixir, and for a hundred years keep the body in peace and health.

src:
桐江秋信早，憶在故山時。
靜夜風鳴磬，無人竹掃墀。
猨來觸淨水，鳥下啄寒棃。
可即關吾事，歸心自有期。
tgt:
On the Tong River autumn news comes early, I recall the time in my hometown.
In the still night wind chimes the stone chime, no one sweeps the steps with bamboo.
Monkeys come and touch the pure water, birds descend to peck cold pears.
Can this concern me? My heart's return has its own time.

src:
渾黄下湍流，地勢東南瀉。
潛石激陰怒，烈風鎮相假。
客行何艱哉，極力無可者。
永路未遽央，扁舟安得捨。
端思九衢塵，快意堅車馬。
tgt:
Muddy yellow torrents rush, the terrain slopes southeast.
Hidden rocks stir secret wrath, fierce winds press without cease.
How hard is the traveler's path, with all strength and no avail.
The endless road shows no quick end, how can the small boat be left?
I think of the dust of nine thoroughfares, where firm carts and horses race with delight.

src:
旧俗传荆楚。
正江城、梅炎藻夏，做成重午。
门艾钗符关何事，付与痴儿呆女。
耳不听、湖边鼍鼓。
独炷炉香熏衣润，对潇潇、翠竹都忘暑。
时展卷，诵骚语。
新愁不障西山雨。
问楼头、登临倦客，有谁怀古。
回首独醒人何在，空把清尊酹与。
漾不到、潇湘江渚。
我又相将湖南去，已安排、吊屈嘲渔父。
君有语，但分付。
tgt:
Old customs pass down through Jing and Chu.
Just as the river city, plum rains and summer's heat,
Make the Double Fifth anew.
Door mugwort and hairpin charms—what do they matter?
Leave them to the foolish boys and girls.
My ears do not listen to the lake's alligator drums.
Alone I burn incense in the censer, scenting my clothes with moisture,
Facing the rustling, emerald bamboos, forgetting the summer heat.
From time to time I unroll a scroll and chant the words of Sao.
New sorrows cannot block the West Mountain rain.
I ask the tower's weary climber, who remembers antiquity?
Looking back, where is the lone sober man?
In vain I pour out the clear cup as a libation.
It cannot ripple to the shores of Xiao and Xiang.
I too will soon go to Hunan,
Already arranged—to mourn Qu Yuan and mock the fisherman.
If you have words, just send them to me.

src:
遺嬰盡雛乳，何況骨肉枝。
心腸結苦誠，胸臆垂甘滋。
事已出古表，誰言獨今奇。
賢人母萬物，豈弟流前詩。
tgt:
The orphaned infants all receive suckling care, how much more one's own flesh and blood branch.
Heart and entrails knit in bitter sincerity, from the breast hangs sweet nourishment.
The deed has already gone beyond ancient models, who says it alone is strange today.
The worthy person mothers all things, kind and gentle, flowing through former poems.

src:
疇昔江湖意，兒曹總不知。
幅巾霑雨過，拄杖看雲移。
鳯子飛應遠，鶯兒語最遲。
閑從梅雪後，直到麥秋時。
tgt:
The old wanderlust of rivers and lakes, the young ones never know.
My cloth cap soaked through by rain, I lean on my cane and watch the clouds drift.
The phoenix chick has flown far, surely; the oriole's song comes latest.
Idly I follow after the plum blossoms and snow, straight on until the wheat harvest time.

src:
爛醉擁貂裘，揮鞭跨紫騮。
客途寒色重，邊地月華愁。
旌旆開前道，江山指別州。
相逢俄作別，滄海一虛舟。
tgt:
Dead drunk in sable fur, I whip my purple steed.
The way is cold for travelers indeed.
The border moon saddens with waning light.
My banners raise before me left and right.
I point to hills and streams of other state.
We meet to part, like a boat disconsolate.

src:
元帥謙謙盡下情，麟堂垂晚更延賓。
遇風盡是同舟客，肯把秦人視越人。

萬事縱橫似亂絲，道人莫道便無思。
五湖風起浪如屋，祇問鸕鷀知不知。
tgt:
All things crisscross like tangled threads, don’t tell the seeker there’s no thought ahead.
Across Five Lakes the wind stirs waves like houses; I only ask the cormorant, does it know or not?

src:
風捲亂雲散，天懸暖日明。
（見《吟窗雜錄》卷十四正字王玄《詩中旨格》）。
tgt:
The wind rolls up scattered clouds, the sky hangs with warm sunlight bright.
(From "Yinchuang Zalu," Volume 14, Zhengzi Wang Xuan's "Shizhong Zhige").

src:
陽回冰底見雲堆，春意東來梅已知。
待得東城花柳放，早春已是得春遲。
tgt:
The sun returns, beneath the ice clouds gather in a heap;
The east wind brings spring's intent, the plum blossoms already know.
Wait until the east city's flowers and willows bloom,
Early spring has already arrived, yet spring seems late.

src:
儒生紙上爭攻剽，傳癖書癡等貽誚。
不然利海競錐刀，或向名場羨華要。
紛紛臧穀兩亡羊，說以西湖却頭掉。
西湖自倚傾城姿，肯與西施角年少。
品題定價有前賢，陳迹班班猶可弔。
試因休沐許尋盟，浄洗緇塵一登眺。
身疑孤星破浮雲，心逐驚猱走空嶠。
野竹萬箇秋聲虛，敗荷十里香風妙。
凌霄金剎梵仙居，怪石嶙峋餘萬竅。
高敷桂子浥新黄，好傍長枝發清嘯。
老禪林外熟蹲鴟，雙耳不聞天使召。
行行欲問處士橋，路轉忽逢水仙廟。
未羞菊蕊薦芳馨，一盞寒泉敢先釂。
翩翩沙鳥沒蒼烟，紅蓼丹楓舞斜照。
急呼艇子汎漪漣，正欲渡間狎漁釣。
同行磊落三數公，嘉此襟期非素料。
襞牋吟寫樂遊詩，愈使西湖有光耀。
伊余同賦却忘言，了知造物工相撩。
千古遊人安在哉，城郭山林歸一窖。
會須象罔得玄珠，可免小兒輕侮笑。
tgt:
Scholars on paper vie in plunder and attack,
Book-mad and verse-obsessed, they earn the same mock.
If not, in seas of profit they race for a blade of gain,
Or at the field of fame they envy splendor and high place.
In confusion, Zang and Gu both lose their sheep,
Speak of West Lake, and they just shake their heads.
West Lake leans on her city-toppling beauty,
Would she vie with Xi Shi in youth?
For grading and pricing there are sages of old,
Their traces still in rows, still fit to mourn.
If by leave I might seek the old pledge,
I would wash off the black dust and climb once to gaze.
My body seems a lone star breaking through floating clouds,
My heart follows a startled monkey racing the empty peaks.
Ten thousand stalks of wild bamboo, autumn sound hollow,
Ten miles of withered lotus, fragrant wind wondrous.
A golden monastery soaring the clouds, a Brahma immortal's dwelling,
Strange rocks jagged, with ten thousand remaining hollows.
High spread cassia seeds, soaked in new yellow,
Best to lean by long branches and let out a clear whistle.
Outside the old Zen grove, the crouching owl is ripe,
Both ears hear no summons from the heavenly envoy.
On and on I would ask for the Recluse's Bridge,
The road turns, and suddenly I meet the Water Immortal's shrine.
I am not ashamed to offer chrysanthemum buds' fragrance,
One cup of cold spring, dare I drink first?
Lightly, lightly sand birds vanish in dark smoke,
Red smartweed and red maple dance in slanting light.
Quickly call the little boat to float on the ripples,
Just as I would cross and dally with fishing and angling.
Fellow travelers, three or four noble men,
Admire this mood and intent, not what common plans would make.
Folding paper, chanting and writing a poem of joyful travel,
All the more gives West Lake glory and shine.
And I, jointly composing, yet forget my words,
Clearly knowing the Creator works to stir us.
Where are the travelers of a thousand years?
City walls and mountain forests return to one pit.
One must let Xiang Wang obtain the dark pearl,
Then can escape the light mockery and laughter of children.

src:
慶壽千齡遠，敷仁萬國通。
登霄欣有路，捧日媿無功。
仙駕三山上，龍生二月中。
修齋長樂殿，講道大明宮。
此地人難到，諸天事不同。
法筵花散後，空界滿香風。
tgt:
Celebrating longevity for a thousand years afar, spreading benevolence to all nations alike.
Joyfully ascending to heaven, there is a path; ashamed of no merit in holding up the sun.
Immortal chariots on the three mountains, dragons born in the second month.
Observing fasts in the Palace of Eternal Joy, expounding the Dao in the Great Brilliance Palace.
This place is hard for people to reach; the affairs of the heavens are different.
After the Dharma feast's flowers are scattered, the realm of emptiness is filled with fragrant wind.

src:
瞿曇幾箇舌頭，衆會幾箇眼睛。
頭頭物物，剎剎塵塵。
自瞞猶自可，最苦是瞞人。
tgt:
How many tongues does Gautama have, how many eyes does the assembly have.
Every head, every thing; every instant, every mote of dust.
Deceiving oneself is still bearable; the worst suffering is deceiving others.

src:
先生方獨往，逝與一世辭。
雖未超雲霞，豈嘗顧喧卑。
事親止于適，接物能不爲。
谷中虎豹多，往往行自隨。
此是真人風，何必太古時。
吾欲從之遊，自嫌迹尚非。
寄心逍遙間，聊可以相期。
tgt:
The masters go their solitary ways, departed from a world of common days.
Though they have not transcended clouds and mist, did they ever look back at clamor and lowliness?
In serving kin they stop at what is fitting; in dealing with things they can refrain from acting.
In the valleys tigers and leopards abound, and often they walk along with them.
This is the air of true men—why must it belong to high antiquity?
I wish to wander in their company, yet I dislike that my traces are still not so.
I lodge my heart in carefree wandering; for now, this may serve as our appointed meeting.

src:
聞道成都酒，無錢亦可求。
不知將幾斗，銷得此來愁。
tgt:
I hear Chengdu's wine can be had without money.
I wonder how many gallons it would take to drown the sorrow I bring.

src:
放出一頭地，出牆梢更新。
傍人爲稱屈，素志肯求伸。
苦節變甘節，曲身成直身。
青霄看直上，莫忘手援人。
tgt:
Let one branch stand out, beyond the wall it grows anew.
Others plead injustice for it, yet its true will seeks no伸展.
Bitter integrity turns to sweet integrity, the bent body becomes straight.
Watch it rise straight to the blue sky, but do not forget to lend a hand to others.

src:
禁門深鎖寂無譁，濃墨淋漓兩相麻。
唱徹五更天未曉，一池月浸紫薇花。
tgt:
The palace gates are locked deep in silent hush,
Two edicts wet with thick ink's flowing brush.
They sing till the fifth watch, dawn still not near,
A pool of moonlight soaks the crape myrtle here.

src:
子晉吹笙未是仙，阿丕橫槊少全篇。
小吟春著梅梢句，一日東風四海傳。
tgt:
Zi Jin's flute-playing did not make him immortal;
A Pi's spear-crossing poems rarely survive whole.
A small song of spring resting on plum branch lines,
In one day east wind spreads it across the four seas.

src:
一陣曉風寒，驚飛點去鞍。
行人易愁絕，便作柳花看。
tgt:
A morning breeze cold blows,
Startling the rider's steed, away it goes.
A traveler's heart is prone to endless grief,
He takes it for willow flowers, brief.

src:
看看，心空骨寒槁木暖，未發髑髏津瀝乾。
秋入眼角，春生鼻端。
相呼相喚知音會，爲我門前倒剎竿。
tgt:
Look, the mind is empty, bones cold, yet the withered tree is warm; before it stirs, the skull's moisture has already dried.
Autumn enters the eye's corner, spring is born at the tip of the nose.
Calling and answering, knowing friends meet; for me, before the gate, the flagpole is toppled.

src:
志在冥鴻上，舟行白鷺羣。
水花明晚色，詩態藹春雲。
獨立興三歎，孤斟爲十分。
錦囊曾不惜，還遣野人聞。
tgt:
My will soars with the dark swan on high,
My boat moves through egrets nearby.
The water blooms in evening light,
Poetic air blends with spring cloud white.
I stand alone and sigh thrice long,
Drinking alone, I'm three parts strong.
I've never grudged my brocade bag,
But let the rustic hear my tale.

src:
府城西北瓦棺東，尚有遺基在此中。
旋折纔方二里許，規模不得小邦同。
正當進取爭彊霸，聊作屯營備敵衝。
老范智謀曾不識，却云爭似建康宮。
tgt:
Northwest of the prefectural city, east of the tile coffin, there still remains a foundation here.
Its winding extent is only about two li or so, its scale cannot be the same as a small state.
Just when advancing to contend for power and hegemony, it merely served as a camp to guard against enemy attacks.
Old Fan's wisdom and strategy once did not recognize this, yet said how could it compare to the Jiankang Palace.

src:
膝横五弦琴，試鼓南風曲。
寄傲北窗下，便覺此生足。
開懷酒一壺，寓意棋一局。
既使風掃門，還將月爲燭。
tgt:
A five-stringed lute lies across my knees; I try to play the Southern Breeze.
Leaning beneath the northern window, I feel this life is enough for me.
With a jug of wine to open my heart, and a game of chess to convey my thought.
Though the wind sweeps my gate, I shall take the moon as my candle.

src:
騎曹新上雪堂西，千里淮南望眼迷。
正我尋雲並滄海，思君步月過黄泥。
清時鼓角無驚夢，勝日樽罍有共携。
人物風流對江浪，數將冰繭寄新題。
tgt:
Riding to Cao's new post west of Snow Hall,
A thousand miles to Huainan, gaze blurred.
Just as I seek clouds by the blue sea,
I think of you treading moon past Yellow Mud.
In peaceful times, drums and horns don't wake dreams,
On fine days, cups and jars we share.
Talents and elegance face the river waves,
Several times sending ice cocoons for new verses.

src:
空（此詩原缺出處，應出《文苑英華》卷二四三，題作《酬張二十員外前成長子博士叔向》，署「張繼」，《全唐詩》據以收於張繼名下，岑仲勉《唐人行第錄》考證此應爲竇叔向詩，張二十即張繼。
此詩題應作《酬張二十員外》，「前國子博士叔向」爲附收入張作時之署名。
後人不明唐集附收之例，因誤作張詩。
）。
tgt:
Empty (This poem originally lacked a source and should have come from "Wenyuan Yinghua," Volume 243, titled "Responding to Zhang the Twentieth, a Supernumerary Official, Formerly the Director of the Directorate of Education, Shuxiang," attributed to "Zhang Ji," and was included under Zhang Ji's name in "Complete Tang Poems." Cen Zhongmian's "Record of Tang Dynasty Forms of Address" verified that this should be a poem by Dou Shuxiang, and Zhang the Twentieth is Zhang Ji.
The title of this poem should be "Responding to Zhang the Twentieth, a Supernumerary Official," with "Formerly the Director of the Directorate of Education, Shuxiang" being the signature appended when it was included among Zhang's works.
Later generations, unaware of the practice of appending works in Tang collections, mistakenly regarded it as Zhang's poem.
).

src:
法身無相，法眼無瑕。
因風吹火，借水獻花。
絲毫不立，萬別千差。
但看來年三二月，啣泥燕子入人家。
tgt:
The Dharma body is formless; the Dharma eye is flawless.
Riding the wind to blow fire, borrowing water to offer flowers.
Not a hair's breadth is established, yet ten thousand differences and a thousand distinctions.
Just wait until the third or second month of next year, when mud-carrying swallows enter people's homes.

src:
安知先長老，不是昔勤公。
爾有五七字，今無六一翁。
tgt:
How do we know Elder Xian wasn't the diligent lord of old?
You have lines of five and seven, but today there's no Old Man of Six-One.

src:
水國苦彫瘵，東臯豈遺黍。
雲陰無盡時，日出常帶雨。
昨夜西溪漲，扁舟入簷廡。
野人同鳥巢，暴客若蜂聚。
歲晏無斗粟，寄身欲何所。
空羨鸞鶴姿，翩翩自輕舉。
tgt:
The waterlands suffer from lingering illness, how could the eastern fields leave any millet behind?
Clouds gather without end, and when the sun rises, it always brings rain.
Last night the western stream swelled, and a small boat entered under the eaves.
Villagers live like birds in nests, while violent strangers gather like swarms of bees.
At year's end, without a bushel of grain, where can I entrust myself?
I can only envy the phoenix and crane's bearing, lightly soaring and fluttering on their own.

src:
去年醉與東湖別，欲上衡湘泛秋月。
君家留我却邅迴，悵望還成阻修闊。
西山縹緲翠屏開，復憶滕王倒玉杯。
經過始識洪崖井，調笑重登孺子臺。
臺前呼酒折荷花，水凈煙明散落霞。
舉杯失笑君何在，望斷行雲空咄嗟。
故人別後還愁緒，此都不是余留處。
興來目送海邊鴻，歸心挂在閩谿樹。
路逢估客有情人，因得題詩一寄君。
大鵬正展圖南翼，空有相思隔海雲。
tgt:
Last year, drunk, I parted from East Lake, wanting to go up the Heng and Xiang to float in the autumn moon.
Your family kept me, yet I lingered, gazing sadly, and still we were kept apart by distance.
The western hills open like a faint green screen, and I recall again the Prince of Teng pouring his jade cup.
Passing through, I first knew the Hongya Well, and joking, climbed again the Ruzi Terrace.
Before the terrace, calling for wine, I broke off lotus flowers; the water was clear, the mist bright, scattering sunset clouds.
Raising my cup, I laughed in spite of myself—where are you? Gazing to the end of the clouds, I sigh in vain.
After parting from old friends, I still have sorrowful thoughts; this capital is not the place for me to stay.
When the mood comes, I watch the seaside geese off with my eyes; my heart for home hangs on the trees by the Min River.
On the road I met a traveling merchant, a man of feeling, and so I wrote a poem to send to you.
The great peng is spreading its wings to journey south; in vain there is longing across the sea clouds.

src:
三峽移名澗響空，中著一橋如飲虹。
旁連濺瀑龍所宮，謂佛有力真冥濛。
非造物意無禹功，一綫偶達成巨谼。
可怪一律人聵聾，助桀唱和更撞舂。
或者誤信晨暮鐘，萬有一幸相際逢。
吾儒自有名教蹤，壁立萬古澗底松。
異端瑣細秋後蛩，一物不格皆妄庸。
誰知健者此山中，樸實可亂田舍翁。
出郊小隊不妨農，黄巖意與考亭通。
長養此道如種穜，駿發爾私雨我公，穮蔉雖饉亦有豐。
常行萬世無汙隆，行健不息人中龍。
不妨更擊白鹿鼓，扣之大小皆舂容。
tgt:
The Three Gorges shift, the named stream echoes in the void, within it a bridge like a drinking rainbow.
Beside it joins a splashing waterfall, the dragon's palace, saying Buddha has power truly dim and vast.
Not the creator's intent, without Yu's merit, a single thread偶然 achieves a giant chasm.
How strange that one tune makes people deaf and mute, aiding Jie in singing along and even pounding.
Or perhaps mistakenly believing the morning and evening bells, in a myriad chances meeting by luck.
We Confucians have our own path of names and teachings, standing like a pine at the bottom of the gorge for all ages.
Heterodoxies are trivial like autumn crickets, if one thing is not investigated, all are false and mediocre.
Who knows the strong one in this mountain, simple and honest enough to confuse a farmhouse elder.
Going out to the suburbs with a small troop does not hinder farming, Huangyan's meaning connects with Kaoting.
Nurturing this way like planting seeds, swiftly developing your private rain for our public, though weeding and hoeing may bring famine, there is also abundance.
Always practicing for all ages without decline or rise, moving vigorously without rest, a dragon among men.
It does not hurt to strike the White Deer Drum again, tapping it, large or small, all resound.

src:
工夫用處沒蹻踦，心手相應合自知。
毫髮盡時消息盡，不妨眼上又安眉。
tgt:
Skill applied leaves no trace of awkwardness, heart and hand respond in harmony, known only to oneself.
When the finest hair is exhausted, the message is exhausted too; there is no harm in adding eyebrows above the eyes.

src:
夢斷窗全曙，兒童競報晴。
層雲擘輕絮，飛鵲噪新聲。
一水長天靜，雙溪萬櫓鳴。
傍簷聊覓句，樂處漫蠅營。
tgt:
Dream broken, all windows bright with dawn, children race to report the clear.
Layered clouds split like light floss, flying magpies clamor with new sound.
One river, long sky still, twin streams, ten thousand oars resound.
By the eaves I idly seek a line, in joy I let the petty buzzing go.

src:
昨時江北望江南，把酒離愁已不堪。
今夜江南望江北，抵掌清談安可得。
歷湖白下非吾鄉，官身俗眼禁人狂。
後日扁舟更西去，江北江南兩何處。
tgt:
Yesterday I gazed from north to south of the river, wine in hand, the sorrow of parting already unbearable.
Tonight from south to north of the river I gaze, can we clap hands and talk freely as before?
Lihu and Baixia are not my homeland; official duties and worldly eyes restrain one's wild spirit.
The day after tomorrow, a small boat will carry me farther west—north of the river, south of the river, where are they both?

src:
杖頭挑起一天雲，政是梅花十月春。
猿叫千山風勢惡，雪迷萬里雨聲頻。
今朝瓢笠游方外，舊處煙霞失主人。
好去著鞭行所得，他時相見話頭新。
tgt:
The staff's tip lifts a sky full of clouds, just when plum blossoms bring October spring.
Monkeys cry across a thousand hills, the wind's force is fierce; snow blinds ten thousand miles, rain's sound is frequent.
Today with gourd and bamboo hat I wander beyond the world; in old haunts, mist and rosy clouds have lost their host.
Go well, whip on your journey and gain what you may; when we meet another time, our talk will be new.

src:
石苔應可踐，叢枝幸易攀。
青溪歸路直，乘月夜歌還。
tgt:
The mossy rocks can surely be trodden upon; the clustered branches are fortunately easy to climb.
The green stream's homeward path is straight; riding the moon, I sing as I return at night.

src:
北園山杏皆高株，新枝放花如點酥。
早來其間有啼鳥，兒女盡識名提壺。
急教取酒對之飲，滿頭亂插紅模糊。
可憐後日再來此，定見隨風如錦鋪。
tgt:
In the north garden, the mountain apricots are all tall trees,
Their new branches bloom like dotted cream.
Early on, among them, there are singing birds,
Children all know their names and call them "pour the wine."
Quickly, bring wine and drink facing them,
Flowers stuck all over my head, a red blur.
Pity that in days to come, when I return here,
I will surely see them spread like brocade in the wind.

src:
芒屨方疑濕，天晴逕又乾。
由來雲在下，木杪是欄干。
tgt:
My straw sandals I thought must be wet,
But the path's dry when the sky is clear.
It has always been that clouds lie low,
And the treetops serve as a railing here.

src:
閒堂風月深，自此出瑶琴。
爲我彈一曲，悠然生古心。
餘清分坐客，微響拂流禽。
世上是非耳，誰能知此音。
tgt:
The idle hall's wind and moonlight run deep; from here comes the jade zither.
Play a tune for me, and carefree ancient feelings arise.
Its lingering clarity is shared among the seated guests; faint echoes brush the passing birds.
In this world of right and wrong ears, who can know this sound?

src:
流傳勝致有無間，投老方能一倚欄。
千里江山來極目，萬家烟雨鎖初寒。
姦雄幾許埋蓁莽，笑語何妨擁蕙蘭。
便覺寸陰真可惜，須將酒戶爲君寬。
tgt:
Word has spread of this splendid scene without pause, yet only in old age can one lean on the rail.
A thousand miles of rivers and mountains stretch to the farthest gaze, ten thousand homes veiled in mist and rain, locked in first cold.
How many treacherous heroes lie buried in tangled brush? What harm in laughing and talking while embracing orchids and thoroughwort?
Then I feel each inch of time is truly to be cherished; I must broaden my drinking capacity for you.

src:
詩名空滿浙江東，身事長嗟似轉蓬。
正是梅天又離別，相思還在雨聲中。
tgt:
My poetic fame fills the east of Zhejiang in vain; I sigh that my life drifts like a tumbleweed.
Just when it is the plum-rain season, we part again; our longing still lingers in the sound of the rain.

src:
何處無苛政，東南有子男。
細將朝客說，須是邑人諳。
別業空經稔，歸田獨未甘。
目凝煙積樹，心貯月明潭。
曉鼓愁方亂，春山睡正酣。
不任啼鳥思，鄉社欲桑蠶。
tgt:
Where is there no harsh rule? In the southeast there are sons and men.
Carefully I speak to the court visitor: it must be the townspeople who know.
My other estate has lain empty for a full year; returning to the fields alone I am not yet content.
My eyes fix on mist gathering in the trees; my heart stores the bright moon in the pool.
At dawn drums, sorrow is just thrown into disorder; in spring mountains, sleep is just deepest.
I cannot bear the thought of crying birds; in the village shrine, they are about to tend mulberries and silkworms.

src:
寒起溪邊蘆荻風，霜林病葉未全紅。
雁隨雲落斜陽外，舟傍山行晚照中。
極目閑愁愁欲絕，滿川離恨恨無窮。
天涯更送親朋去，尊酒何時再得同。
tgt:
Cold rises from the riverbank where reeds wind-blown sway,  
Frosted forest leaves, not yet all red, decay.  
Geese follow clouds beyond the slanting sun's descent,  
A boat hugs the mountains in the evening's fading light.  
Gazing far, idle sorrow nears its breaking point,  
The river brims with parting grief that knows no end.  
At the world's edge, I see off kin and friends once more—  
When shall we share a cup of wine together again?

src:
兵發（京本作「發兵」）日，天氣久陰沉。
不雨又無光彩色，奸人謀事（京本作「士」）恨懷心，仔細速（京本作「早」）推尋。
tgt:
On the day troops are dispatched, the weather stays gloomy for long.
No rain, yet no bright colors either; treacherous people plot and harbor resentment in their hearts—investigate carefully and quickly.

src:
梅已飄零尚典刑，斷魂籬落野烟青。
靈均憔悴迺知此，到老可人寧獨醒。
tgt:
The plum blossoms have fallen, yet their spirit remains, a broken soul by the fence, wild smoke green.
Qu Yuan, haggard, understood this—who, till old, could stay sober and still be pleasing?

src:
漆書寘蘭臺，筆削猶敢擅。
真名鏤遺編，定知伯喈篆。
未校芸閣書，成此石經殿。
tgt:
Lacquer writing placed in the Orchid Terrace, still daring to wield the brush to edit.
True names engraved in the surviving texts, surely known as Bojie's seal script.
Not yet collated the books of the Yun Pavilion, this Stone Classic Hall is completed.

src:
十年揮素學臨池，始識王公學衛非。
草聖未須因酒發，筆端應解化龍飛。
tgt:
For ten years I practiced calligraphy with plain silk, learning by the pond,
Only then did I realize Master Wang was wrong to learn from Lady Wei.
The Sage of Cursive need not rely on wine for inspiration;
From the tip of his brush, he should know how to transform and fly like a dragon.

src:
十方世界口相吞，不斷圓音說普門。
唯有普菴知說處，一箇窮人不著裩。
tgt:
In the ten directions, worlds devour one another mouth to mouth; ceaseless perfect sound proclaims the universal gate.
Only Puan knows where this teaching is spoken: a single poor man wearing no pants.

src:
曾不見譊譊，城中類遠郊。
雖無千里馬，却有一枝巢。
月出雲山背，風來松竹梢。
頑然何所得，豈復避人嘲。
tgt:
Never have I seen such clamor, the city seems like distant suburbs.
Though there's no thousand-mile steed, there is a single branch for a nest.
The moon rises behind cloudy mountains, wind comes to the tips of pines and bamboos.
Stubbornly, what have I gained? How could I again avoid people's mockery?

src:
笙流觶揚，少長位辨。
已事而竣，不誡用勸。
tgt:
The reed pipes flow, the goblets raise, young and old take their places clear.
When the task is done, without admonition they are encouraged.

src:
理財非鑿空，簡訟在謹始。
林繁去冗根，巵漏無溢水。
此理容可觀，妙處要深體。
豈惟宰一邑，天下亦如此。
tgt:
Wealth management is not groundless; avoiding disputes lies in caution from the start.
A dense forest removes redundant roots; a leaking cup holds no overflowing water.
This principle may be observed, but its subtlety must be deeply experienced.
How could it apply only to governing a town? The world is also like this.

src:
悠悠行路雪侵頭，擬出重關洗弊裘。
堤上忽逢憔悴客，背花停酒說通州。
tgt:
Slowly I walk, snow gathering on my head,
I plan to leave the pass and wash my worn fur coat.
On the embankment I suddenly meet a haggard traveler,
Turning from the flowers, pausing his wine, he speaks of Tongzhou.

src:
鄭公賦政鬢如絲，符竹新分晉水湄。
招客遠郊常置驛，論文古訓舊箋詩。
漢庭行曳尚書履，涇谷曾刊隠士碑。
今日湖亭共遊汎，追懷子美昔同時。
tgt:
Lord Zheng's governance turns his temples grey like silk, his new commission by the Jin River's edge.
He invites guests to the far suburbs, where relay stations are often set; discussing texts and ancient teachings, old annotations and poems.
At the Han court, he'll walk in the Minister's shoes; in Jing Valley, he once inscribed the hermit's stele.
Today, at the lake pavilion, we roam and float together, recalling Zimei from the same time past.

src:
入城不識公與卿，行歌道上旁無人。
衣衫藍縷鶉百結，與妻索笑妻生嗔，那知不是朱買臣。
tgt:
Entering the city, I know neither lords nor ministers, singing as I walk the road, no one else in sight.
My clothes are ragged, patched a hundred times like a quail's plumage; I seek a smile from my wife, but she grows angry—how could she know I am not Zhu Maichen?

src:
境界本來無善惡，人間何處有新圖。
欲知箇裏真消息，臘月寒松永不枯。
tgt:
The realm originally has no good or evil, where in the human world is there a new picture?
If you want to know the true message within, the cold pine in the twelfth month never withers.

src:
霧紅煙白忽橫陳，雨後風光聖得新。
說似遊人須著便，陰寒已破一分春。
tgt:
Red mist and white smoke suddenly spread out wide, after the rain the scenery looks holy and new.
Tell the travelers they must take advantage, the cold has already broken a share of spring.

src:
霅水論交今有誰，兩翁華髪映朝衣。
功名晼晚君流落，衰病栖遲我倦飛。
叔夜相思能肯顧，子猷乘興却言歸。
人生動是參商别，三復清詩對落暉。
tgt:
By the Zha River, who now shares friendship true?
Two white-haired elders gleam in courtly dress.
Your fame came late, and now you wander far;
I, sick and weary, rest from flight's distress.
Would Shuye, thinking of me, deign to call?
Ziyou, stirred by whim, then turned for home.
Life's partings are like Shen and Shang stars, apart;
I read your clear poems thrice beneath the setting sun.

src:
老僧真是百無能，有口何嘗話葛藤。
入定參禪良自苦，超凡入聖又誰曾。
東西路別徒勞泣，南北宗分自取憎。
箇裏無禪亦無佛，常行粥飯在家僧。
tgt:
This old monk truly is utterly incapable, with a mouth that has never spoken of tangled vines.
Entering meditation and investigating Chan is truly self-imposed suffering; transcending the ordinary and entering sagehood—who has ever done that?
Weeping in vain as the roads part east and west; dividing into Northern and Southern schools only brings self-loathing.
In this, there is no Chan and no Buddha; always eating congee and rice, a home-dwelling monk.

src:
於穆元后，天臨紫宸。
飛緌星拱，建羽林芬。
徽冊是奉，鴻名愈新。
荷茲介祉，永永無垠。
tgt:
How majestic is the empress, descending from heaven to the purple palace.
Flying tassels like stars surrounding, the feathered forest arrayed in splendor.
The imperial edict is respectfully received, her great name ever renewed.
Bearing this great blessing, forever and ever without bounds.

src:
市夾河漘好，橋當浦口雄。
濕雲低障日，斜雨急收風。
石岸蜿蜒去，松江杳靄中。
知幾吾晚矣，慚汗過垂虹。
tgt:
The market by the riverbank is fine, the bridge stands grand at the estuary.
Damp clouds hang low, blocking the sun; slanting rain quickly calms the wind.
The rocky shore winds away, into the misty depths of Songjiang.
How late I am to know the subtle signs, ashamed, sweating, I cross the垂虹.

src:
池上先生詩句香，得公詩句更揄揚。
精神相對陳圭瓚，意氣潜交冶鏌將。
賢令舊容老文學，山農今見謫仙郎。
百年剩喜風流續，未有名禽首屢昂。
tgt:
The verses of Mr. Chishang are fragrant; gaining your verses brings even greater praise.
Spirits face each other like presented jade tablets; temperaments secretly blend like forged Moye swords.
The worthy magistrate once showed kindness to an old scholar; the mountain farmer now sees the banished immortal youth.
For a hundred years, I am left with joy that this elegance continues; before any famed bird, my head repeatedly lifts.

src:
莫惜朝來准酒錢，淵明身即是花仙。
重陽滿滿杯中泛，一縷黄金是一年。

寒雲四塞客日短，一壺臍裂洪疇中。
君家大門我父黨，覓白聊復相過從。
和香索料多甲煎，幽蘭幾弄理孤桐。
爾來行李偶南北，齒齒不見雲間峰。
登山臨水不無思，獨笑往往捫長松。
蓬門春晚燕語好，書幌迤邐來清風。
五府带垢一洗盡，萬里古色開愁胸。
輞川何在廣文死，比比孺子誇有功。
楚人僅免二日苦，却嗟白璧埋蒿蓬。
逡巡取酒敘契闊，百川赴吸驚長虹。
風流未愧正始後，淪落丘范評無鍾。
君才有用豈特爾，我亦相將成老翁。
騏驎得路即千里，會看拭目天邊鴻。

洛城無事足杯盤，風雪相和歲欲蘭。
樹上因依見寒鳥，坐中收拾盡閑官。
笙歌要請頻何爽，笑語忘機拙更歡。
遙想兔園今日會，瓊林滿眼映旂竿。
tgt:
In Luoyang, all is calm, with cups and plates in view; wind and snow blend as the year nears its end.
On the trees, one can see cold birds clinging; among those seated, all idle officials are gathered.
When songs and music are requested, how often they flow freely; in laughter and talk, forgetting schemes, clumsiness brings more joy.
Far off, I imagine today's gathering at the Rabbit Garden; a forest of jade fills the eyes, reflecting flagpoles.

src:
小橋通南浦，夾道桑榆綠。
水繞若連珠，風傳芰荷馥。
tgt:
A small bridge leads to the southern shore, mulberries and elms line the path in green.
The water winds like a string of pearls, the wind carries the fragrance of water caltrop and lotus.

src:
人間幾日變桑田，誰識神仙洞裏天。
短促共知有□異，且須歡醉在生前。
tgt:
How many days before the world turns to mulberry fields?
Who knows the immortal's cave heaven?
We all know life is short and different,
So we must drink and be merry before death.

src:
孤亭一目盡天涯，俯瞰烟村八九家。
翠壁何年懸布水，綠陰經雨墮危花。
杖藜徙倚凝春望，覓句淹留到晚衙。
珍重詩翁莫相惱，枯腸攪斷鬢絲華。
tgt:
From the lone pavilion, one glance takes in the ends of the earth,
Looking down on eight or nine mist-veiled village homes.
On emerald cliffs, since what year has the waterfall hung?
In green shade, after rain, precarious blossoms fall.
Leaning on my staff, lingering, I gaze intently at spring,
Seeking lines, detained until the evening court.
Cherish the old poet, do not be vexed with one another,
My dried-up guts are churned and broken, my temple threads are white.

src:
拖阴笼晚暝，商量清苦，阵阵打篷声。
分明都是泪，不道今宵，篷底有离人。
松涛摇睡，梦不稳、难湿巫云。
几点儿、泪痕跳响，休要醒时听。
销魂。
灯下无语，□泣梨花，掩重门夜永。
应是添、伤春滋味，中酒心情。
东风湖上香泥软，明日去、天色须晴。
相见也，洛阳沽酒旗亭。
tgt:
Dragging shadows cage the late dusk, discussing clear bitterness, wave after wave the awning sound.
Clearly all are tears, not saying tonight, beneath the awning is a parting one.
Pine waves shake sleep, dreams unsteady, hard to wet the Wu clouds.
A few drops, tear stains leap and sound, do not listen when awake.
Soul-crushing.
Under the lamp speechless, □ weeping pear blossoms, shutting the layered doors the night is long.
Surely adding, the taste of spring grief, the mood of being drunk.
East wind on the lake, fragrant mud soft, tomorrow going, the sky must clear.
When we meet, in Luoyang buy wine at the flag pavilion.

src:
乱烟簇。
帘外青山渐肃。
莲房静。
荷盖半残，欲放清涟媚溪绿。
凭高送远目。
飞起沧洲雁骛。
寒窗静，茶碗未深，一枕胡床画眠足。
闲行问松菊。
今□雨谁家，空对银烛。
箫声忽下瑶台曲。
看鹤舞风动，乌啼云起，何须舟内怨女哭。
抱琴写幽独。
情触。
会相续。
况节近中元，月浪翻屋。
长鲸愁晓寒蟾促。
要百柁倾□，万花流玉。
山肴倒尽，又空腹，鲙野蔌。
tgt:
Dense mist gathers in chaos.
Beyond the curtains, green hills gradually turn solemn.
The lotus seedpod is still.
Lotus leaves are half withered, yet want to release clear ripples that charm the green stream.
Leaning on the height, I send my gaze far away.
Flying up are gulls and ducks from the misty isle.
By the cold window, all is quiet; the teacup is not yet deep.
On a folding couch, a painted sleep is enough.
Idly walking, I ask after the pines and chrysanthemums.
Today, whose home is this in the rain, facing silver candles in vain?
Suddenly, the sound of a flute descends like a tune from a jade terrace.
I watch cranes dance as the wind stirs, crows cry as clouds rise; no need for a grieving woman to weep in a boat.
Holding a zither, I write of secluded solitude.
Emotion is stirred.
We will meet and continue.
Moreover, the festival is near the Middle Prime; moonlight surges and overturns the house.
The long whale grieves at dawn's cold; the cold toad urges.
It takes a hundred rudders to overturn □, ten thousand flowers flow like jade.
Mountain delicacies are poured out completely, and again an empty belly, minced wild vegetables.

src:
世變無窮客恨長，欄干遍倚怕斜陽。
滿籬黄菊無心看，付與游蜂自在忙。
tgt:
The world changes endlessly, a traveler's grief grows long; I lean on every rail, dreading the slanting sun.
A fence full of yellow chrysanthemums I have no heart to see; I leave them to the wandering bees, busy at their ease.

src:
農事正紛紛，天時异所聞。
舉頭方見日，翻手又爲雲。
茅舍蛙分部，槐庭蟻失羣。
裁成憂國疏，齋沐告吾君。
tgt:
Farm work is in full swing, the weather differs from what's heard.
Lifting my head, I just see the sun; turning my hand, it becomes clouds again.
In the thatched cottage, frogs divide their posts; in the pagoda-tree courtyard, ants have lost their swarm.
Having finished drafting a memorial out of concern for the realm, I fast and bathe to report to my lord.

src:
積潦高秋後，幽居病客心。
每憐荷折蓋，猶愛菊包金。
獨坐有餘恨，臨觴莫厭深。
多情省郎直，永夜祗清吟。
tgt:
After the heavy autumn rains have pooled,
The sick guest's heart in quiet dwelling grieves.
I always pity the lotus broken its canopy,
Yet still love chrysanthemums wrapped in gold.
Sitting alone, I have lingering regrets,
Facing the cup, do not tire of its depth.
The tender-hearted provincial official on duty,
Through the long night only chants clear verses.

src:
此去廬陵定幾程，向來筇杖未經行。
懸知征棹雲邊集，大有吟情雪裏生。
tgt:
How many stages to Luling from here, I ask?
My bamboo staff has never traveled this way.
I know your boat will gather where clouds mass,
And much poetic feeling in snow will grow.

src:
天涯客里秋容晚。
妖红聊戏思乡眼。
一朵醉深妆。
羞渠照鬓霜。
开时谁断送。
不待司共花。
有脚号阳春。
芳菲属主人。
tgt:
A wanderer at the world's end, autumn's face is late.
The bewitching red merely teases homesick eyes.
A single bloom, drunk with deep makeup.
Ashamed to mirror the frost on my temples.
When it blooms, who sends it off?
It does not wait for the flower official.
With feet, it is called阳春.
The fragrance and beauty belong to the host.

src:
翛翛樓下竹，㶁㶁竹間水。
樓高雖不見，清響長在耳。
晨光露西崦，積玉照窗紙。
崑閬亦何人，當從跨金鯉。
tgt:
Whispering the bamboo below the tower, gurgling the water among the bamboo.
Though the tower is high and cannot see, the clear sound lingers in the ear.
Morning light dew on the western ridge, piled jade shines on the window paper.
Who is that in Kunlun and Langfeng? Should follow across on a golden carp.

src:
芳草未應羞鵯鵊，潜鱗終是畏提壺。
蔡經背上痕猶在，更念麻姑指爪無。
tgt:
The fragrant grass should not shame the bulbul,
The hidden fish still fear the pelican.
The marks on Cai Jing's back remain,
Do we still think of Magu's fingernails?

src:
衆寶國土寶樓閣，寶樹更兼池間錯。
此箇總觀若成時，名爲粗見彼極樂。
tgt:
In the land of many jewels, pavilions and towers stand,
With jeweled trees and ponds interwoven across the land.
When this overall contemplation is complete and true,
It is called a rough vision of that Land of Bliss.

src:
吾皇有意縛單于，槌破銅山鑄虎符。
驍將新除三十六，精兵共領五千都。
周王常德須攘狄，漢帝雄才亦尚儒。
君學本兼文武術，功名不必讀孫吳。
tgt:
The emperor intends to capture the Xiongnu chief,
Smashing copper mountains to cast tiger tallies.
Thirty-six valiant generals newly appointed,
Five thousand elite troops all under command.
King Zhou's constant virtue required repelling the Di,
Emperor Han's heroic talent also esteemed Confucianism.
Your learning originally combines civil and martial arts,
For fame and merit, no need to read Sun Wu.

src:
頓轡揮毫墨尚新，碧紗從此碧生塵。
可憐庭下長楊樹，猶有清陰待路人。
tgt:
Reining in my horse, I write with ink still fresh and new;
Beneath the green gauze, dust gathers as the years accrue.
How pitiful the tall willow in the courtyard stands,
Still offering its cool shade to passersby with gentle hands.

src:
鵷鴻俱失侶，同爲此地遊。
露浥荷花氣，風散柳園秋。
煙草凝衰嶼，星漢泛歸流。
林高初上月，塘深未轉舟。
清言屢往復，華樽始獻酬。
終憶秦川賞，端坐起離憂。
tgt:
The phoenix and swan both have lost their mates, together they wander this place.
Dew soaks the lotus fragrance, wind scatters the autumn of the willow garden.
Misty grass congeals on the fading isle, the Milky Way floats on the returning stream.
The woods are high as the moon first rises, the pond is deep and the boat has not turned.
Pure words go back and forth repeatedly, splendid cups begin the toast and reply.
At last I recall the pleasures of Qinchuan, sitting upright, rising sorrow of parting.

src:
酒香渾若過新豐，心事悠悠冷笑中。
徹夜道傍梔葉雨，幾年馬上桂枝風。
高情未許愁能挽，歸意惟應夢可通。
準擬今秋剩追逐，暗泉鏘佩月潭東。
tgt:
The wine's fragrance seems to pass by Xinfeng's old way,
In lingering thoughts, a cold smile holds its sway.
All night by the roadside, gardenia leaves meet the rain,
For years on horseback, laurel blossoms ride the wind's lane.
Lofty sentiments won't let sorrow pull them down,
Only in dreams can the wish to return be found.
I plan to chase what remains of this autumn's grace,
By the moonlit pool's east, where hidden springs chime in place.

src:
潜虬拔地徑夭矯，騰拏勢出青雲表。
爲誰猶向此中蟠，坐閲春秋昏復曉。
團團高蓋月輪平，矗矗蒼叢衆星小。
枯槎當面結生香，外有霜皮細勻遶。
乃知造化有神巧，散作樛枝窮樹杪。
雖非直榦棟梁材，怪怪奇奇樂幽窈。
獨秀海山臨浩漾，駭浪翻空雲縹渺。
茁芽自有甘露滋，弄影幾經霜月皎。
崢嶸老氣本天然，後生矯揉何時了。
我家揚州真好事，買歸但覺千金少。
夜半有力欲負之，護持和璧終歸趙。
從來寫照無髣髴，畫師欲快毫端掃。
解衣盤礴意慘澹，卷起生綃色徒愀。
我來青邊立寒峭，自憐氣與秋天杳。
倚筇一笑賓亦歡，開尊相與傾清醥。
謂當好此如好賢，爲君三復緇衣篇。
時時來前看不足，終待結屋平湖邊。
tgt:
The hidden dragon uproots the ground, its path graceful and curved,
Its soaring posture rises beyond the blue clouds.
For whom does it still coil here,
Sitting through spring and autumn, dusk and dawn?
Round and round, its high canopy levels with the moon's wheel,
Towering and verdant, it makes the myriad stars seem small.
A withered branch before my face bears fresh fragrance,
Outside, frosty bark wraps it evenly and fine.
Thus I know nature's divine craftsmanship,
Scattering gnarled branches to the very treetops.
Though not a straight trunk fit for beams and pillars,
Strange and wondrous, it delights in secluded depths.
Alone elegant, it overlooks the vast sea and mountains,
Startling waves churn the sky, clouds dim and distant.
Its sprouting buds are nourished by sweet dew,
Its dancing shadow has weathered many a frosty moon.
Its towering old spirit is naturally so,
When will the young ones' forced contortions ever end?
My family in Yangzhou is truly fond of such things,
Buying it back, I felt a thousand gold was still too little.
At midnight, a strong force would carry it away,
But guarding it like a jade disk, it finally returns to Zhao.
Never has any portrait captured its likeness,
The painter wishes to speed his brush to the tip.
Undressing and sitting cross-legged, his mood is bleak,
Rolling up the raw silk, its colors only sadden.
I come to stand by the green edge in cold austerity,
Pitying myself, my spirit is as vast as autumn sky.
Leaning on my staff, I smile, and my guests rejoice too,
Opening wine jars, together we pour clear brew.
I say one should love this as one loves the worthy,
For you, I thrice repeat the "Black Robe" poem.
From time to time I come before it, never seeing enough,
At last I'll wait to build a hut by the calm lake's edge.

src:
俯視紛華等粃糠，隨時邀樂任嬪嬙。
宮中鬭草知多少，自有金芝冠衆芳。
tgt:
Looking down on worldly splendor as chaff and husks, taking pleasure with consorts as the seasons allow.
How many grass-fighting games are there in the palace? There is a golden mushroom that crowns all flowers.

src:
蕭條獨向汝南行，客路多逢漢騎營。
古木蒼蒼離亂後，幾家同住一孤城。
tgt:
Bleak and alone, I go to Runan's town;
On the way I oft meet Han cavalries.
After the war, ancient trees are dark green.
How many families live in one lone town?

src:
幾年埋沒亂荆榛，軒檻移來特地新。
何事臨風忍相對，傷心一曲舊亡陳。
tgt:
For years it lay buried among thorns and brush,
Moved to the porch, it shines with special freshness.
Why face it in the wind and bear to look?
A broken heart, one song of a fallen past.

src:
少年落魄走京華，老大無錢赴酒家。
羞作寺丞門裏客，一片明月照梅花。
tgt:
In youth, down and out, I wandered to the capital's busy street;
In age, without money, I can't go where wine and friends meet.
Ashamed to be a guest in the temple minister's hall,
I see only the bright moon shining on mume blossoms small.

src:
小雨初涼夜，殘燈欲暗時。
病多愁近酒，心弱怯題詩。
舊友殊方少，歸耕晚歲宜。
回頭語孤影，此意有君知。
tgt:
A light rain brings first chill to the night, as the dying lamp dims.
Illness makes me dread wine, and my frail heart fears writing poems.
Old friends are few in distant lands; returning to farm in late years suits me.
Turning my head, I speak to my lone shadow: this feeling only you know.

src:
谷雨风前，占淑景、名花独秀。
露国色仙姿，品流第一，春工成就。
罗帏护日金泥皱。
映霞腮动檀痕溜。
长记得天上，瑶池阆苑曾有。
千匝绕、红玉阑干，愁只恐、朝云难久。
须款折、绣囊剩戴，细把蜂须频嗅。
佳人再拜抬娇面，敛红巾、捧金杯酒。
献千千寿。
愿长恁、天香满袖。
tgt:
Before the Grain Rain wind, she claims the fair scene, a famous flower standing alone.
Dew reveals her national beauty and immortal grace, first in rank and quality, perfected by spring's work.
A silk canopy shields the sun, its golden mud wrinkles.
Glowing like rosy clouds, her cheeks stir, sandalwood traces glide.
I long remember in heaven, in the Jade Pool and Langyuan, she once was there.
A thousand turns around the red jade railing, I worry only that morning clouds are hard to keep.
I must gently break her off, keep wearing her in a brocade sachet, and often sniff her bee-like stamens.
The beauty bows again and lifts her delicate face, gathers her red kerchief, and holds up a golden cup of wine.
Offering a thousand thousand birthdays.
I wish to always have heaven's fragrance filling my sleeves.

src:
秋葉已多蠹，古原看更荒。
廢城無馬入，破冢有狐藏。
寒日稍清迥，寒山分漭蒼。
田衣指白水，此下是雷塘。
tgt:
Autumn leaves are riddled with worms, the ancient plain looks even more desolate.
No horses enter the ruined city, foxes hide in broken tombs.
The cold sun is somewhat clear and far, cold mountains divide the vast expanse.
A field robe points to white water, below here is Leitang.

src:
黄昏簷溜垂瀑，清曉屐聲滿門。
湖光萬頃何似，小沼先吹縠紋。
tgt:
At dusk, from the eaves, a waterfall pours down;
At dawn, the sound of clogs fills the house.
How does the vast lake compare?
On the small pond, ripples first stir the air.

src:
汪子文章何偉奇，如觀天子乘輿儀。
怛然暴見殊驚疑，舌拄上齶兩目癡。
定神屏氣試引窺，漸識羽衛行相隨。
金吾佽飛開中逵，橫刀執矟鐵馬馳。
畫旆赤白盤龍螭，大角一百二十支。
鐃鼓嘲轟雜橫吹，繡幡絳幢何紛披。
䍐罼鈹戟開黄麾，屬車{車急}轔霹靂移。
侍郎御史冠峨危，圓扇孔雀雙翅垂。
辟邪白澤飛麟麒，金輅赤馬火鬣鬐。
飄飄鳳蓋翳華芝，水光鐵甲羽林兒。
二十四仗驅熊貔，長殳闊劍梢魍夔。
團花絳袖武士衣，大小不同雖異宜。
要之盡是聖賢爲，奇服怪玩一不施。
斥之所以尊皇威，汪子之文正類斯。
一十五軸紛葳蕤，爛光直欲紙上飛。
長篇短篇傾珠璣，題說論序及賦詩。
篇雖不同皆有歸，要之孔子韓退之。
留讀旬日不知疲，大渴適得甘露飴。
我欲誦記留肝脾，惟我老鈍無記持。
又無小吏操筆揮，或可寫留慰朝饑。
二者不遂其齎咨，今復奪去心黭黟。
室中斗覺無光輝，靈寶不可留洿池。
風雨送還滄海湄，嗟我居陳逾歲時。
兩耳無聞如塞泥，遂恐聾瞶不可醫。
子來乃得時攻治，摐金伐石鳴鼓鼙。
氣豪却似相凌欺，因子文章張我師。
使我發此狂簡辭。
tgt:
Wang Zi's writings, how magnificent and rare, like viewing the Son of Heaven's carriage procession.
Startled and suddenly exposed, I am especially shocked and doubtful, tongue stuck to the roof of my mouth, both eyes dazed.
Steadying my spirit and holding my breath, I try to draw near and peek, gradually recognizing the feathered guards advancing in succession.
The imperial guards and swift warriors open the central path, bearing swords and holding spears, iron horses galloping.
Painted banners in red and white coil with dragons and hornless dragons, the great horns number one hundred and twenty.
Handbells and drums clash and boom, mixed with transverse flutes, embroidered streamers and crimson pennants, how they flutter and spread.
Halberds and pikes open the way for the yellow command banner, attendant carriages rattle like thunder as they move.
The vice minister and censor wear towering caps, round fans with peacock feathers hang down on both sides.
Evil-averting beasts, white marsh beasts, flying qilin, golden carriages and red horses with fiery manes.
Floating phoenix canopies shade the splendid mushrooms, water-glinting iron armor on the Feathered Forest soldiers.
Twenty-four ceremonial guards drive bears and panthers, long spears and broad swords graze the specters.
Round-flowered crimson sleeves on warriors' garments, great and small differ, though each is fitting.
In sum, all are made by sages and worthies, strange garments and bizarre curiosities are not displayed at all.
Rejecting them is how imperial majesty is honored, and Wang Zi's writing is exactly like this.
Fifteen scrolls, lush and abundant, their brilliant light seems about to fly off the paper.
Long pieces and short pieces pour out pearls and jade, prefaces, discussions, essays, and poems.
Though the pieces differ, all have their归宿, in sum, Confucius and Han Tuizhi.
Keeping them to read for ten days, I do not know fatigue, like one parched who just got sweet dew and syrup.
I want to recite and remember them, keep them in my liver and spleen, but I am old and dull and have no memory to retain them.
And I have no petty clerk to wield a brush, or I might write them down to relieve my morning hunger.
Neither of these two can be fulfilled, and my sighs of regret, now they are taken away again, my heart is dark and black.
In my room I suddenly feel there is no radiance, a sacred treasure cannot remain in a stagnant pool.
Wind and rain send it back to the shores of the blue sea, alas, I have lived in Chen for more than a year.
My two ears hear nothing, as if stuffed with mud, and I fear deafness cannot be cured.
You came, and then I could get timely treatment, striking metal and cutting stone, sounding drums and war drums.
Your spirit is bold, yet it seems to bully and oppress, through your writing you have raised up my master.
And made me utter these wild and simple words.

src:
水本無心作浪波，經行偶與石相磨。
不須更問橋安否，喚取於菟載我過。
tgt:
Water, by nature, has no wish to make waves; it flows along and happens to grind against stones.
There is no need to ask whether the bridge is safe; call the tiger to carry me across.

src:
天意只如此，將軍足可傷。
忠無身報主，冤有骨封王。
苔雨樓牆暗，花風廟路香。
沉思百年事，揮淚灑斜陽。
tgt:
The will of heaven is just so, the general is pitiable enough.
Loyal, with no body to repay his lord; wronged, with bones to be enfeoffed as a king.
Moss and rain darken the tower walls; flower-scented wind perfumes the temple road.
Pondering deeply on a century of affairs, I shed tears in the slanting sunlight.

src:
莊嚴起何代，幽佚惟天與。
有衆倚耕桑，無人歎寒暑。
嵐氛蠹金碧，谷響酬鐘鼓。
白晝方丈西，猶眠聽經虎。
tgt:
When did this solemn temple rise? Its quiet leisure is heaven's gift alone.
The people here rely on farming and mulberry; no one sighs over cold or heat.
Mountain mist gnaws at the gold and jade splendor; valley echoes answer bell and drum.
In broad daylight, west of the abbot's quarters, a tiger still sleeps, listening to the sutras.

src:
孤竹赤松子，定交泉石間。
不關渠勢利，落得自蕭閒。
畫寫景中景，雲分山外山。
興來時散策，興盡便知還。
tgt:
